title.zh: 卷六十六 志第十九 五行四
title.raw: 卷六十六 志第十九 五行四 Volume 66 Treatises 19: Five Elements 4

sentences.zh: 从革，金性也。

translations.literal: Transformation and refinement—that is the nature of Metal.
translations.idiomatic: "Following reform" is the nature of Metal.

sentences.zh: 金失其性，则为变怪。

translations.literal: When Metal loses its nature, then there are strange transformations.
translations.idiomatic: When Metal falls out of its proper nature, anomalies and portents arise.

sentences.zh: 旧说以僭咎、恒旸、诗妖、民讹、毛虫之孽，白眚、白祥之类皆属之金，今从之。

translations.literal: The old theory holds that transgression-portents, chronic sunshine, poetic omens, popular rumor-omens, calamities among hairy creatures, white calamities, white auspicious signs, and the like all belong to Metal; now we follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier scholars classified usurpation-portents, persistent drought, verse omens, popular rumor-songs, calamities among hairy creatures, and white calamities and white auspices as belonging to Metal; this treatise follows that scheme.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年七月，晋州神山县北谷中有铁随水流出，方二丈三尺，其重七千斤。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Jianlong, in the northern valley of Shenshan County, Jin Prefecture, iron flowed out with the water; it measured two zhang and three chi square and weighed seven thousand jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Jianlong (961), iron issued forth with the water in the northern valley of Shenshan County in Jin Prefecture; the mass was about twenty-three feet across and weighed seven thousand jin.

sentences.zh: 太平兴国四年九月，夹江县民王谊得黑石二，皆丹文，其一云“君王万岁”，其二云“赵二十一帝”，缄其石来献。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, the commoner Wang Yi of Jiajiang County obtained two black stones, both with cinnabar inscriptions; one read "May the sovereign live ten thousand years," the other "Twenty-one emperors of Zhao"; he sealed the stones and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo (979), Wang Yi, a commoner of Jiajiang County, found two black stones inscribed in cinnabar—one reading "Long live the sovereign," the other "Twenty-one emperors of Zhao"—and presented them sealed for the court.

sentences.zh: 至道二年二月，桂阳监熔银自涌成山峰状。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Zhidao, at the Guiyang Directorate, molten silver surged up by itself into the shape of a mountain peak.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Zhidao (996), silver being smelted at the Guiyang Directorate welled up on its own into a peak-like mass.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年十二月，亳州太清宫钟自鸣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Xianping, the bell of the Supreme Clarity Palace in Bozhou sounded of itself.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Xianping (1001), the bell at the Supreme Clarity Palace in Bozhou rang without being struck.

sentences.zh: 乾兴元年四月甲戌，修奉山陵总管言：皇堂隧道穿得铜锅，有两耳，又于寝宫三门下穿得铜盂一、铁瓮一、铁甲叶三。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the fourth month of the first year of Qianxing, the overseer of the imperial tomb works reported: in boring the tunnel of the imperial hall they pierced through to a bronze pot with two handles; and beneath the three gates of the sleeping palace they pierced through to one bronze basin, one iron urn, and three iron armor scales.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the fourth month of the first year of Qianxing (1022), the director of tomb construction reported that tunneling for the imperial hall had broken through to a two-handled bronze cauldron, and that beneath the three gates of the sleeping palace workers had uncovered one bronze basin, one iron jar, and three iron armor scales.

sentences.zh: 天圣元年三月庚辰，涪陵县相轧寺夜有光出阿育王塔之旧址，发之，得金铜像三百二十七。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the third month of the first year of Tiansheng, at Xiangya Temple in Fuling County, by night a light appeared at the old site of the Ashoka Stupa; when they excavated, they obtained three hundred twenty-seven gilt bronze images.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the third month of the first year of Tiansheng (1023), a light appeared by night at the former site of the Ashoka Stupa at Xiangya Temple in Fuling County; excavation yielded three hundred twenty-seven gilt bronze statues.

sentences.zh: 五年七月壬寅，辽山县旧河凌地摧塔，获古钱一百四十六千五百四十三文。

translations.literal: On renyin day in the seventh month of the fifth year, at the old river-ice ground of Liaoshan County a pagoda collapsed; they obtained ancient coins in the amount of one hundred forty-six thousand five hundred forty-three cash.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the seventh month of the fifth year (1027), a pagoda collapsed on former river-ice ground in Liaoshan County, and one hundred forty-six thousand five hundred forty-three old coins were recovered.

sentences.zh: 明道元年五月壬午，汉州江岸获古钟一。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the fifth month of the first year of Mingdao, on the riverbank of Han Prefecture an ancient bell was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the fifth month of the first year of Mingdao (1032), an ancient bell was found on the Han Prefecture riverbank.

sentences.zh: 庆历四年五月乙亥，金溪县得生金山，重三百二十四两。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the fifth month of the fourth year of Qingli, Jinxi County obtained a mountain of native gold weighing three hundred twenty-four liang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the fifth month of the fourth year of Qingli (1044), a deposit of native gold weighing three hundred twenty-four liang was found in Jinxi County.

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年，乾宁军渔人得小钟二于河滨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangyou, fishermen of Qianning Army obtained two small bells on the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Huangyou (1052), fishermen of Qianning Army found two small bells on the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 五年二月己亥，乾宁军又进古钟一。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the second month of the fifth year, Qianning Army again presented one ancient bell.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the second month of the fifth year (1053), Qianning Army presented another ancient bell.

sentences.zh: 至和二年四月甲午，浏阳县得古钟一。

translations.literal: On jiawu day in the fourth month of the second year of Zhihe, Liuyang County obtained one ancient bell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the fourth month of the second year of Zhihe (1055), an ancient bell was found in Liuyang County.

sentences.zh: 熙宁元年至元丰元年，横州共获古铜鼓一十七。

translations.literal: From the first year of Xining to the first year of Yuanfeng, Heng Prefecture in all obtained seventeen ancient bronze drums.
translations.idiomatic: Between the first year of Xining (1068) and the first year of Yuanfeng (1078), Heng Prefecture recovered seventeen ancient bronze drums in all.

sentences.zh: 元丰三年八月，岳州永庆寺获铜钟一、铜磬二。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Yuanfeng, Yongqing Temple in Yue Prefecture obtained one bronze bell and two bronze chimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Yuanfeng (1080), Yongqing Temple in Yue Prefecture acquired one bronze bell and two bronze chime stones.

sentences.zh: 六年，南溪县穿土得铜钱五万四千有奇。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Nanxi County in digging earth obtained fifty-four thousand odd cash coins.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1083), excavations in Nanxi County turned up more than fifty-four thousand copper coins.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，筠州获古铜钟一。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, Jun Prefecture obtained one ancient bronze bell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year (1084), Jun Prefecture recovered an ancient bronze bell.

sentences.zh: 十一月，宾州获铜鼓一。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Bin Prefecture obtained one bronze drum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Bin Prefecture recovered a bronze drum.

sentences.zh: 八年，昌元县通盐井得铜锅九、铜盆一、铜盘一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, at the salt well in Changyuan County they obtained nine bronze pots, one bronze basin, and one bronze tray.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1085), work at the salt well in Changyuan County uncovered nine bronze cauldrons, one bronze basin, and one bronze tray.

sentences.zh: 崇宁五年十月，荆南获古铜鼎。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Chongning, Jingnan obtained an ancient bronze tripod.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Chongning (1106), an ancient bronze tripod was found in Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，玄圭始出。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe, the Dark Gui first appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenghe (1112), the Dark Gui jade tablet first came to light.

sentences.zh: 晋州上一石，绿色，方三尺余，当中有文曰“尧天正”，其字如掌大而端楷类手画者，“尧”字居右，“天正”字缀行于左。

translations.literal: Jin Prefecture presented a stone, green in color, more than three chi square; in the center were characters reading "Yao Tian Zheng"; the characters were as large as a palm, upright and regular like hand-drawn script—the character "Yao" on the right, the characters "Tian Zheng" continuing in a line to the left.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Prefecture submitted a green stone more than three feet square, inscribed at the center with "Yao Tian Zheng" in upright characters as large as a palm, seemingly hand-drawn—"Yao" on the right and "Tian Zheng" in a line to the left.

sentences.zh: 都堂验视，砻石三分而字画愈明，又于“尧”字之下隐约出一“瑞”字，位置始均，盖曰“天正尧瑞”云。

translations.literal: The metropolitan office inspected it; when the stone was ground down three fen the characters and lines became clearer still, and beneath the character "Yao" a character "Rui" faintly emerged; the positions then became even—altogether it read "Tian Zheng Yao Rui," it is said.
translations.idiomatic: When the metropolitan office examined the stone and polished away three fen of its surface, the inscription grew clearer; beneath "Yao" a faint "Rui" appeared, balancing the layout—taken together as "Heaven's rectitude, Yao's auspice."

sentences.zh: 或谓晋阳，尧都也，方玄圭出，乃有此瑞。

translations.literal: Some said that Jinyang was the capital of Yao, and just as the Dark Gui appeared, therefore there was this auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Some held that since Jinyang had been Yao's capital, the appearance of the Dark Gui explained this omen.

sentences.zh: 四年，府畿、汝、蔡之间，连山大小石皆变为玛瑙，尚方取为宝带、器玩甚富。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, between the capital district, Ru, and Cai, stones large and small on successive mountains all turned into agate; the imperial workshop took them for precious belts and vessels in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1114), stones throughout the hills between the capital region, Ru, and Cai turned to agate; the imperial workshop fashioned them into jeweled belts and luxuries in great quantity.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，湖南提举常平刘钦言：芦荻冲出生金，重九斤八两，状类灵芝祥云；

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, Liu Qin, Hunan intendant for the Ever-Normal Granaries, reported: at Ludichong native gold appeared, weighing nine jin eight liang, in shape like lingzhi fungus and auspicious clouds;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year (1115), Liu Qin, Hunan's Ever-Normal intendant, reported that native gold had appeared at Ludichong, weighing nine jin eight liang, shaped like lingzhi fungus and auspicious clouds;

sentences.zh: 又淘得碎金四百七两有奇。

translations.literal: and they also panned four hundred seven odd liang of gold dust.
translations.idiomatic: and that panning had yielded more than four hundred seven liang of gold dust besides.

sentences.zh: 十一月，越州民拾生金。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, commoners of Yue Prefecture picked up native gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, commoners in Yue Prefecture gathered native gold.

sentences.zh: 湟州丁羊谷金坑仅千余眼得矿，成金共四等，计一百三十四两有奇。

translations.literal: At the Dingyang Valley gold pits in Huang Prefecture, from only a little more than a thousand shafts ore was obtained; refined gold in all four grades totaled one hundred thirty-four odd liang.
translations.idiomatic: At the Dingyang Valley mines in Huang Prefecture, barely a thousand shafts yielded ore; smelted gold of four grades totaled more than one hundred thirty-four liang.

sentences.zh: 宣和四年后，御府所藏，往往复变为石，而色类白骨，此与周宝圭占略同。

translations.literal: After the fourth year of Xuanhe, what the imperial storehouse held often turned back into stone, and the color was like white bone—this is broadly the same as the omen of the Zhou precious gui.
translations.idiomatic: After the fourth year of Xuanhe (1122), treasures in the imperial collection often reverted to stone of a bone-white hue—a portent akin to the Zhou precious gui omen.

sentences.zh: 五年，荥阳县贾谷山麒麟谷采石修明堂，得一石有文曰“明”，百官表贺。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, quarrying stone at Qilingu in Jiagu Mountain, Xingyang County, to repair the Bright Hall, they obtained a stone with an inscription reading "Ming"; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1125), quarrying at Qilin Valley on Jiagu Mountain in Xingyang County for Bright Hall repairs, workers found a stone inscribed "Ming"; officials throughout the court offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，又获甗鼎三。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year, they again obtained three yan tripods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year, three yan tripods were also recovered.

sentences.zh: 崇宁四年三月，铸九鼎，用金甚厚，取九州水土内鼎中。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Chongning, the Nine Tripods were cast, using metal very thick; soil and water from the Nine Provinces were placed inside the tripods.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year of Chongning (1105), the Nine Tripods were cast with exceptionally thick metal, each filled with soil and water from the Nine Provinces.

sentences.zh: 既奉安于九成宫，车驾临幸，遍礼焉，至北方之宝鼎，忽漏水溢于外。

translations.literal: After they were installed at Jiucheng Palace, the imperial carriage visited and paid respects throughout; when it came to the precious tripod of the North, suddenly water leaked and overflowed outside.
translations.idiomatic: Once installed at Jiucheng Palace, the emperor visited and paid homage to each; at the northern tripod, water suddenly seeped and spilled over the rim.

sentences.zh: 刘炳谬曰：“正北在燕山，今宝鼎但取水土于雄州境，宜不可用。

translations.literal: Liu Bing wrongly said: "True north lies at Yanshan; now the precious tripod took soil and water only from within Xiong Prefecture—it should not be usable."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bing wrongly argued: "True north lies in the Yan Mountains, yet this tripod's fill came only from Xiong Prefecture—it ought not to serve."

sentences.zh: ”其后竟以北方致乱。

translations.literal: Afterward turmoil indeed came from the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the end, disorder did indeed arise from the north.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年，南京留守朱胜非夜防城，见南门外火光烛地，掘之，得铜印，有文曰“朱胜私印”。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianyan, Zhu Shengfei, defender of Nanjing, patrolled the walls by night and saw firelight illuminating the ground outside the south gate; when they dug, they obtained a bronze seal with an inscription reading "Zhu Sheng private seal."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyan (1127), Zhu Shengfei, defender of Nanjing, on a night patrol saw firelight outside the south gate; digging there, he found a bronze seal inscribed "Zhu Sheng, private seal."

sentences.zh: 火铄金，金所畏也。

translations.literal: Fire melts Metal; that which Metal fears.
translations.idiomatic: Fire conquers Metal—Metal's bane.

sentences.zh: 后拜相，有明受之变，卒坐眨。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Chancellor; there was the Mingshou coup; in the end he was punished with demotion.
translations.idiomatic: He later became chief minister; after the Mingshou coup he was ultimately demoted and disgraced.

sentences.zh: 三年，吉州修城，役夫得髑髅弃水中，俄浮一钟，有铭五十六字，大略云：“唐兴元年，吾子没，瘗庐陵西垒，后当火德五九之际，世衰道败，浙、梁相继丧乱，章贡康昌之日，吾亦复出是邦，东平鸠工，复使吾子同河伯听命水官。

translations.literal: In the third year, when Ji Prefecture repaired its walls, laborers obtained a skull and cast it into the water; presently a bell floated up, with an inscription of fifty-six characters, broadly saying: "In the first year of Tangxing, my son died; I buried him at the western rampart of Luling. Later, at the juncture of the Fire Phase and the Five-Nine cycle, the age will decline and the Way fail; Zhe and Liang will suffer disorder in succession. On the day when Zhang and Gong are prosperous and flourishing, I too shall again emerge in this state; Dongping will gather workers and again make my son, together with the Earl of the River, obey the command of the Water Official."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1129), during wall repairs in Ji Prefecture, laborers threw a skull into the water; a bell soon floated up bearing fifty-six characters, in substance: "In the first year of Tangxing my son died and I buried him at Luling's western rampart. When the Fire Phase reaches the Five-Nine turning, the age will decay and the Way collapse; Zhe and Liang will fall in turn. When Zhang and Gong flourish, I shall return to this land; Dongping will muster workers and set my son, with the River Earl, to obey the Water Official's command."

sentences.zh: ”郡守命录其辞，录毕而钟自碎。

translations.literal: The prefect ordered the text copied; when the copying was finished the bell shattered of itself.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect had the inscription copied; as soon as the transcript was complete, the bell shattered on its own.

sentences.zh: 绍兴十一年三月庚申，长安兵刃皆生火光。

translations.literal: On gengshen day in the third month of the eleventh year of Shaoxing, weapons in Chang'an all produced firelight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the third month of the eleventh year of Shaoxing (1141), weapons throughout Chang'an glowed with firelight.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，郫县地出铜马，高三尺，制作精好，风雨夜嘶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the ground in Pixian County produced a bronze horse three chi high, finely made; on stormy nights it neighed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1156), the earth in Pixian County yielded a three-foot bronze horse of exquisite workmanship that neighed on stormy nights.

sentences.zh: 绍兴中，耕者得金瓮重二十四钧于秦桧别业。

translations.literal: During Shaoxing, a plowman obtained a gold urn weighing twenty-four jun at Qin Hui's private estate.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoxing era, a farmer plowing Qin Hui's private estate unearthed a gold jar weighing twenty-four jun.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年三月丙午夜，福清县石竹山大石自移，声如雷。

translations.literal: At midnight on bingwu day in the third month of the second year of Qiandao, a great stone on Shizhu Mountain in Fuqing County moved of itself, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on bingwu day in the third month of the second year of Qiandao (1166), a great boulder on Shizhu Mountain in Fuqing County shifted on its own with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 石方可九丈，所过成蹊，才四尺，而山之木石如故。

translations.literal: The stone measured about nine zhang square; where it passed a path was formed, only four chi wide, yet the mountain's trees and stones were as before.
translations.idiomatic: The stone was roughly ninety feet across; it left a four-foot-wide track in its wake, yet the mountain's trees and rocks elsewhere were untouched.

sentences.zh: 庆元二年十二月，吴县金鹅乡铜钱百万自飞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Qingyuan, at Jine Township, Wu County, a million cash coins flew of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Qingyuan (1196), a million copper coins at Jine Township in Wu County were seen to fly through the air unaided.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，京师夏旱，冬又旱。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, the capital had summer drought; winter again drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianlong (961), the capital suffered drought in summer and again in winter.

sentences.zh: 三年，京师春夏旱。

translations.literal: In the third year, the capital had spring and summer drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (962), the capital suffered drought through spring and summer.

sentences.zh: 河北大旱，霸州苗皆焦仆。

translations.literal: Hebei had great drought; seedlings in Bazhou all withered and fell.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei suffered severe drought; crops in Bazhou withered to the ground.

sentences.zh: 又河南、河中府、孟、泽、濮、郓、齐、济、滑、延、隰、宿等州并春夏不雨。

translations.literal: Also Henan, Hezhong Prefecture, Meng, Ze, Pu, Yan, Qi, Ji, Hua, Yan, Xi, Su, and other prefectures alike had no rain in spring and summer.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Hezhong Prefecture, and the prefectures of Meng, Ze, Pu, Yan, Qi, Ji, Hua, Yan, Xi, and Su likewise saw no rain through spring and summer.

sentences.zh: 四年，京师夏秋旱。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the capital had summer and autumn drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (963), the capital suffered drought in summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 又怀州旱。

translations.literal: Also Huai Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Prefecture was also stricken with drought.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年冬，京师旱。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Qiande, the capital had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Qiande (963), the capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，京师旱。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, the capital had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year (964), the capital was dry.

sentences.zh: 夏，不雨。

translations.literal: In summer, no rain.
translations.idiomatic: Summer brought no rain.

sentences.zh: 是岁，河南府、陕、虢、麟、博、灵州旱，河中府旱甚。

translations.literal: That year, Henan Prefecture, Shan, Guo, Lin, Bo, and Ling Prefecture had drought; Hezhong Prefecture had drought very severe.
translations.idiomatic: That year Henan Prefecture and the prefectures of Shan, Guo, Lin, Bo, and Ling were dry; Hezhong Prefecture suffered especially severe drought.

sentences.zh: 四年春，京师不雨。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, the capital had no rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year (966), the capital saw no rain.

sentences.zh: 江陵府、华州、涟水军旱。

translations.literal: Jiangling Prefecture, Hua Prefecture, and Lianshui Army had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling Prefecture, Hua Prefecture, and Lianshui Army all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，京师旱；

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, the capital had drought;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year (967), the capital was dry;

sentences.zh: 秋，复旱。

translations.literal: in autumn, drought again.
translations.idiomatic: autumn brought drought again.

sentences.zh: 开宝二年夏至七月，京师不雨。

translations.literal: From summer to the seventh month of the second year of Kaibao, the capital had no rain.
translations.idiomatic: From summer through the seventh month of the second year of Kaibao (969), the capital saw no rain.

sentences.zh: 三年春夏，京师旱。

translations.literal: In the spring and summer of the third year, the capital had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring and summer of the third year (970), the capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 邠州夏旱。

translations.literal: Bin Prefecture had summer drought.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Prefecture suffered summer drought.

sentences.zh: 五年春，京师旱；

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, the capital had drought;

sentences.zh: 帝问致旱之由，中书舍人胡交修奏守臣周祀残酷所致，寻以属吏坐赃及杀不辜，窜岭南。

translations.literal: The emperor inquired into the cause of the drought; Secretariat Drafter Hu Jiaoxiu memorialized that Prefect Zhou Si's cruelty was the cause; soon, on account of subordinate officials' guilt of embezzlement and killing the innocent, he was banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked what had brought the drought; Hu Jiaoxiu of the Secretariat replied that the prefect Zhou Si's cruelty was to blame; soon afterward, after subordinates were found guilty of embezzlement and wrongful killing, Zhou was exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，旱，至于七月，帝蔬食露祷，乃雨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, drought; until the seventh month, the emperor ate vegetables and prayed in the open air, and then rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year drought set in and lasted until the seventh month; the emperor ate plain food and prayed in the open air, and rain finally came.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，浙东、西旱五十余日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, eastern and western Zhe had drought for more than fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, eastern and western Zhe suffered drought for more than fifty days.

sentences.zh: 六月，江东、湖南旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Jiangdong and Hunan had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Jiangdong and Hunan were dry.

sentences.zh: 秋，四川郡国旱甚。

translations.literal: In autumn, the commanderies and kingdoms of Sichuan had very severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, the commanderies of Sichuan suffered extremely severe drought.

sentences.zh: 六年，夔、潼、成都郡县及湖南衡州皆旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the commanderies and counties of Kui, Tong, and Chengdu, and Heng Prefecture in Hunan, all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the commanderies and counties of Kui, Tong, and Chengdu, and Hengzhou in Hunan, all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 七年春，旱七十余日，时帝将如建业，随所在分遣从臣，有事于名山大川。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, drought for more than seventy days; at that time the emperor was about to go to Jianye, and wherever he went he separately dispatched attending ministers to offer rites at famous mountains and great rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year drought lasted more than seventy days; as the emperor was about to travel to Jianye, he dispatched attending ministers from each place he reached to offer rites at famous mountains and great rivers.

sentences.zh: 六月，又旱，江南尤甚。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, drought again; Jiangnan was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month drought returned, and Jiangnan was hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 八年冬，不雨。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighth year, no rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighth year, no rain fell.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，旱六十余日，有事于山川。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, drought for more than sixty days; rites were performed at mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year drought lasted more than sixty days, and rites were performed at the mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月，旱。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eleventh year, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eleventh year, drought struck.

sentences.zh: 戊申，有事于岳渎。

translations.literal: On day wushen, rites were performed at the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, rites were performed at the sacred mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，祷雨于圜丘、方泽、宗庙。

translations.literal: On day yimao, rain was prayed for at the Circular Mound, the Square Marsh, and the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, prayers for rain were offered at the Circular Mound, the Square Marsh, and the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，旱六十余日。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, drought for more than sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twelfth year, drought lasted more than sixty days.

sentences.zh: 秋，京西、淮东旱。

translations.literal: In autumn, Jingxi and Huaidong had drought.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Jingxi and Huaidong suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十二月，陕西旱。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Shaanxi had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Shaanxi was dry.

sentences.zh: 十八年，浙东、西旱，绍兴府大旱。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, eastern and western Zhe had drought; Shaoxing Prefecture had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, eastern and western Zhe suffered drought, and Shaoxing Prefecture was gripped by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 十九年，常州、镇江府旱。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Chang Prefecture and Zhenjiang Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, Changzhou and Zhenjiang Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，浙东、西旱。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, eastern and western Zhe had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, eastern and western Zhe were dry.

sentences.zh: 二十九年二月，旱七十余日。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-ninth year, drought for more than seventy days.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-ninth year, drought lasted more than seventy days.

sentences.zh: 秋，江、浙郡国旱。

translations.literal: In autumn, the commanderies and kingdoms of Jiang and Zhe had drought.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, the commanderies of Jiang and Zhe suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，阶、成、凤、西和州旱。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year, Jie Prefecture, Cheng Prefecture, Feng Prefecture, and Xihe Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirtieth year, Jiezhou, Chengzhou, Fengzhou, and Xihezhou all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 秋，江、浙郡国旱，浙东尤甚。

translations.literal: In autumn, the commanderies and kingdoms of Jiang and Zhe had drought; eastern Zhe was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, the commanderies of Jiang and Zhe were dry, and eastern Zhe was hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 隆兴元年，江、浙郡国旱，京西大旱。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, the commanderies and kingdoms of Jiang and Zhe had drought; Jingxi had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longxing, the commanderies of Jiang and Zhe suffered drought, and Jingxi was gripped by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 二年，台州春旱。

translations.literal: In the second year, Taizhou had spring drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Taizhou suffered spring drought.

sentences.zh: 兴化军、漳、福州大旱，首种不入，自春至于八月。

translations.literal: Xinghua Army, Zhang Prefecture, and Fu Prefecture had great drought; the first planting could not be done, from spring until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua Army, Zhangzhou, and Fuzhou suffered severe drought, and the first planting could not be done from spring through the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年春，四川郡县旱，至于秋七月，绵、剑、汉州、石泉军尤甚。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year of Qiandao, the commanderies and counties of Sichuan had drought; until the seventh month of autumn, Mian Prefecture, Jian Prefecture, Han Prefecture, and Shiquan Army were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year of Qiandao, drought struck the commanderies and counties of Sichuan and lasted until the seventh month of autumn; Mianzhou, Jianzhou, Hanzhou, and Shiquan Army were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 四年夏六月，旱，帝将撤盖亲祷于太乙宫而雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the summer of the fourth year, drought; the emperor was about to remove the canopy and personally pray at the Taiyi Palace, and rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year drought struck; as the emperor was about to remove his canopy and pray in person at the Taiyi Palace, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 时襄阳、隆兴、建宁亦旱。

translations.literal: At that time Xiangyang, Longxing, and Jianning also had drought.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiangyang, Longxing, and Jianning were also dry.

sentences.zh: 八月，诏颁皇祐祀龙法于郡县。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict ordered the promulgation of the Huangyou dragon-worship rites to commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, an edict ordered the dragon-worship rites of the Huangyou era promulgated to commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 五年夏秋，淮东旱，盱眙、淮阴为甚。

translations.literal: In the summer and autumn of the fifth year, Huaidong had drought; Xuyi and Huaiyin were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer and autumn of the fifth year, Huaidong suffered drought, and Xuyi and Huaiyin were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，浙东、福建路旱，温、台、福、漳、建为甚。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year, eastern Zhe and the Fujian circuit had drought; Wen, Tai, Fu, Zhang, and Jian were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the sixth year, eastern Zhe and the Fujian circuit were dry; Wenzhou, Taizhou, Fuzhou, Zhangzhou, and Jianzhou were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 七年春，江西东、湖南北、淮南、浙、婺秀州皆旱；

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, eastern Jiangxi, northern Hunan, Huainan, Zhe, Wu Prefecture, and Xiu Prefecture all had drought;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year, eastern Jiangxi, northern Hunan, Huainan, Zhe, Wuzhou, and Xiuzhou all suffered drought;

sentences.zh: 夏秋，江、洪、筠、潭、饶州、南康、兴国、临江军尤甚，首种不入。

translations.literal: In summer and autumn, Jiang, Hong, Jun, Tan, Rao Prefectures, Nankang, Xingguo, and Linjiang Army were especially severe; the first planting could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: In summer and autumn Jiang, Hong, Jun, and Tan prefectures, Raozhou, Nankang, Xingguo, and Linjiang Army were hit especially hard, and the first planting could not be done.

sentences.zh: 冬，不雨。

translations.literal: In winter, no rain.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, no rain fell.

sentences.zh: 九年，婺、处、温、台、吉、赣州、临江、南安诸军、江陵府皆久旱，无麦苗。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Wu, Chu, Wen, Tai, Ji, Gan Prefectures, Linjiang, Nan'an armies, and Jiangling Prefecture all had long drought; there were no wheat seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Wuzhou, Chuzhou, Wenzhou, Taizhou, Jizhou, Ganzhou, Linjiang and Nan'an armies, and Jiangling Prefecture all suffered prolonged drought, and no wheat seedlings appeared.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，浙东、湖南郡国旱，台、处、郴、桂为甚。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, the commanderies and kingdoms of eastern Zhe and Hunan had drought; Tai, Chu, Chen, and Gui were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chunxi, drought struck the commanderies of eastern Zhe and Hunan; Taizhou, Chuzhou, Chenzhou, and Guizhou were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 蜀关外四州旱。

translations.literal: The four prefectures beyond Shu Pass had drought.
translations.idiomatic: The four prefectures beyond Shu Pass suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，江、淮、浙皆旱，绍兴、镇江、宁国、建康府、常、和、滁、真、扬州、盱眙、广德军为甚。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year, Jiang, Huai, and Zhe all had drought; Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Jiankang Prefectures, Chang, He, Chu, Zhen, Yang Prefecture, Xuyi, and Guangde Army were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn of the second year, the Jiang, Huai, and Zhe regions all were dry; Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, Jiankang, Changzhou, Hezhou, Chuzhou, Zhenzhou, Yangzhou, Xuyi, and Guangde Army were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，常、昭、复随郢金洋州、江陵德安兴元府、荆门汉阳军皆旱。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year, Chang, Zhao, Fu, Sui, Ying, Jin, and Yang prefectures, Jiangling, Dean, and Xingyuan Prefectures, and Jingmen and Hanyang armies all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year, Changzhou, Zhaozhou, Fuzhou, Suizhou, Yingzhou, Jinzhou, Yangzhou, Jiangling, Dean, Xingyuan, Jingmen, and Hanyang all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 四年春，襄阳府旱，首种不入。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, Xiangyang Prefecture had drought; the first planting could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, Xiangyang was dry, and the first planting could not be done.

sentences.zh: 五年，常、绵州、镇江府及淮南、江东西郡国旱，有事于山川群望。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Chang and Mian Prefectures, Zhenjiang Prefecture, and the commanderies and kingdoms of Huainan and Jiangdong and Jiangxi had drought; rites were performed at the mountains, rivers, and collective sacred sites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Changzhou, Mianzhou, Zhenjiang, and the commanderies of Huainan and Jiangdong and Jiangxi suffered drought, and the court performed rites at the mountains, rivers, and collective sacred sites.

sentences.zh: 六年，衡、永、楚州、高邮军旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Heng, Yong, and Chu Prefectures and Gaoyou Army had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Hengzhou, Yongzhou, Chuzhou, and Gaoyou Army all were dry.

sentences.zh: 七年，湖南春旱，诸道自四月不雨，行都自七月不雨，皆至于九月。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Hunan had spring drought; the various circuits had no rain from the fourth month, and the traveling capital had no rain from the seventh month, all lasting until the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Hunan suffered spring drought; the circuits went without rain from the fourth month, and the traveling capital from the seventh month, and drought persisted in both until the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 绍兴、隆兴、建康、江陵府、台、婺、常、润、江、筠、抚、吉、饶、信、徽、池、舒、蕲、黄、和、浔、衡、永州、兴国、临江、南康、无为军皆大旱，江、筠、徽、婺州、广德军、无锡县尤甚，祷雨于天地、宗庙、社稷、山川群望。

translations.literal: Shaoxing, Longxing, Jiankang, and Jiangling Prefectures; Tai, Wu, Chang, Run, Jiang, Jun, Fu, Ji, Rao, Xin, Hui, Chi, Shu, Qi, Huang, He, Xun, Heng, and Yong prefectures; Xingguo, Linjiang, Nankang, and Wuwei armies all had great drought. Jiang, Jun, Hui, and Wu prefectures, Guangde Army, and Wuxi County were especially severe. Rain was prayed for at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, the altars of soil and grain, and the mountains, rivers, and collective sacred sites.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing, Longxing, Jiankang, Jiangling, Taizhou, Wuzhou, Changzhou, Runzhou, Jiangzhou, Junzhou, Fuzhou, Jizhou, Raozhou, Xinzhou, Huizhou, Chizhou, Shuzhou, Qizhou, Huangzhou, Hezhou, Xunzhou, Hengzhou, Yongzhou, Xingguo, Linjiang, Nankang, and Wuwei all suffered severe drought; Jiangzhou, Junzhou, Huizhou, Wuzhou, Guangde Army, and Wuxi County were hit especially hard, and rain was prayed for at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, the altars of soil and grain, and the mountains, rivers, and collective sacred sites.

sentences.zh: 八年正月甲戌，积旱始雨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, on the day jiaxu, accumulated drought finally brought rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, on the day jiaxu, rain finally came after prolonged drought.

sentences.zh: 七月，不雨，至于十一月：临安、镇江、建康、江陵、德安府、越、婺、衢、严、湖、常、饶、信、徽、楚、鄂、复、昌州、江阴、南康、广德、兴国、汉阳、信阳、荆门长宁军及京西、淮郡皆旱。

translations.literal: From the seventh month, no rain until the eleventh month: Lin'an, Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Jiangling, and Dean Prefectures; Yue, Wu, Qu, Yan, Hu, Chang, Rao, Xin, and Hui; Chu, E, Fu, and Chang prefectures; Jiangyin, Nankang, Guangde, Xingguo, Hanyang, Xinyang, Jingmen, and Changning armies, and the Jingxi and Huai commanderies all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: From the seventh month through the eleventh month it did not rain: Lin'an, Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Jiangling, Dean, Yuezhou, Wuzhou, Quzhou, Yanzhou, Huzhou, Changzhou, Raozhou, Xinzhou, Huizhou, Chuzhou, Ezhou, Fuzhou, Changzhou, Jiangyin, Nankang, Guangde, Xingguo, Hanyang, Xinyang, Jingmen, Changning, and the Jingxi and Huai commanderies all were dry.

sentences.zh: 九年夏五月，不雨，至于秋七月，江陵、德安、襄阳府、润、婺、温、处、洪、吉、抚、筠、袁、潭、鄂、复、恭、合、昌、普、资、渠、利、阆、忠、涪、万州、临江、建昌、汉阳、荆门、信阳、南平、广安、梁山军、江山、定海、象山、上虞、、嵊县皆旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year's summer, no rain until the seventh month of autumn; Jiangling, Dean, and Xiangyang Prefectures; Run, Wu, Wen, Chu, Hong, Ji, Fu, Jun, Yuan, Tan, E, Fu, Gong, He, Chang, Pu, Zi, Qu, Li, Lang, Zhong, Fu, and Wan prefectures; Linjiang, Jianchang, Hanyang, Jingmen, Xinyang, Nanping, and Guangan armies; Liangshan Army; Jiangshan, Dinghai, Xiangshan, Shangyu, and Sheng counties all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year it did not rain until the seventh month of autumn; Jiangling, Dean, Xiangyang, Runzhou, Wuzhou, Wenzhou, Chuzhou, Hongzhou, Jizhou, Fuzhou, Junzhou, Yuanzhou, Tanzhou, Ezhou, Fu Prefecture, Gongzhou, Hezhou, Changzhou, Puzhou, Zizhou, Quzhou, Lizhou, Langzhou, Zhongzhou, Fuzhou, Wanzhou, Linjiang, Jianchang, Hanyang, Jingmen, Xinyang, Nanping, Guangan, Liangshan, Jiangshan, Dinghai, Xiangshan, Shangyu, and Sheng all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十年六月旱，至于七月，江淮、建康府、和州、兴国军、恭、涪、泸、合、金、州、南平军旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year there was drought until the seventh month; Jianghuai, Jiankang Prefecture, He Prefecture, Xingguo Army, Gong, Fu, Lu, He, and Jin prefectures and Nanping Army had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year drought lasted into the seventh month; Jianghuai, Jiankang, Hezhou, Xingguo, Gongzhou, Fuzhou, Luzhou, Hezhou, Jinzhou, and Nanping all were dry.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，不雨，至于八月，兴元府、吉、赣、福、泉、汀、漳、潮、梅、循、邕、宾、象、金、洋、西和州、建昌军皆旱，兴元、吉尤甚。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, no rain until the eighth month; Xingyuan Prefecture; Ji, Gan, Fu, Quan, Ting, Zhang, Chao, Mei, Xun, Yong, Bin, Xiang, Jin, and Yang prefectures; Xihe Prefecture; and Jianchang Army all had drought; Xingyuan and Ji were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eleventh year it did not rain until the eighth month; Xingyuan, Jizhou, Ganzhou, Fuzhou, Quanzhou, Tingzhou, Zhangzhou, Chaozhou, Meizhou, Xunzhou, Yongzhou, Binzhou, Xiangzhou, Jinzhou, Yangzhou, Xihe, and Jianchang all suffered drought, and Xingyuan and Jizhou were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 冬，不雨，至于明年二月。

translations.literal: In winter, no rain until the second month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: That winter it did not rain until the second month of the following year.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月，旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year there was drought.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，有事于山川群望。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuyin, rites were performed at the mountains, rivers, and collective sacred sites.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day wuyin, the court performed rites at the mountains, rivers, and collective sacred sites.

sentences.zh: 甲申，帝亲祷于太乙宫。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the emperor personally prayed at the Taiyi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, the emperor prayed in person at the Taiyi Palace.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，大雩于圜丘，望于北郊，有事于岳、渎、海凡山川之神。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day jiyou, a great rain prayer ceremony was held at the Circular Mound; offerings were made at the northern suburb, and rites were performed for the spirits of peaks, rivers, seas, and all mountains and streams.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day jiyou, the court held a great rain prayer ceremony at the Circular Mound, made offerings at the northern suburb, and performed rites to the spirits of peaks, rivers, seas, and all mountains and streams.

sentences.zh: 时临安、镇江、绍兴、隆兴府、严、常、湖、秀、衢、婺、处、明、台、饶、信、江、吉、抚、筠、袁州、临江、兴国、建昌军皆旱，越、婺、台、处、江州、兴国军尤甚，至于九月，乃雨。

translations.literal: At that time Lin'an, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing, and Longxing Prefectures; Yan, Chang, Hu, Xiu, Qu, Wu, Chu, Ming, Tai, Rao, Xin, Jiang, Ji, Fu, Jun, and Yuan prefectures; and Linjiang, Xingguo, and Jianchang armies all had drought. Yue, Wu, Tai, Chu, Jiang Prefecture, and Xingguo Army were especially severe; rain came only in the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Lin'an, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing, Longxing, Yanzhou, Changzhou, Huzhou, Xiuzhou, Quzhou, Wuzhou, Chuzhou, Mingzhou, Taizhou, Raozhou, Xinzhou, Jiangzhou, Jizhou, Fuzhou, Junzhou, Yuanzhou, Linjiang, Xingguo, and Jianchang all were dry; Yuezhou, Wuzhou, Taizhou, Chuzhou, Jiangzhou, and Xingguo were hit especially hard, and rain did not come until the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 十五年，舒州旱。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Shu Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Shuzhou suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 庆元二年五月，不雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Qingyuan, no rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Qingyuan it did not rain.

sentences.zh: 三年，潼、利、夔路十五郡旱，自四月至于九月，金、蓬、普州大旱；

translations.literal: In the third year, fifteen commanderies of the Tong, Li, and Kui circuits had drought from the fourth month until the ninth month; Jin, Peng, and Pu prefectures had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, fifteen commanderies in the Tong, Li, and Kui circuits were dry from the fourth month through the ninth month, and Jinzhou, Pengzhou, and Puzhou suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 四月壬子，祷于天地、宗庙、社稷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day renzi, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day renzi, the court prayed at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，旱；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year there was drought.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，祷于郊丘、宗社。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinwei, prayers were offered at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinwei, the court prayed at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 镇江府、常州大旱，水竭，淮郡自春无雨，首种不入，及京、襄皆旱。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang Prefecture and Chang Prefecture had great drought and waters dried up; the Huai commanderies had no rain from spring and the first planting could not be done; Jing and Xiang also all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang and Changzhou suffered severe drought and their waters ran dry; the Huai commanderies had gone without rain since spring and the first planting could not be done, and Jing and Xiang were dry as well.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年五月，旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jiatai, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Jiatai there was drought.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，祷于郊丘、宗社。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, prayers were offered at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, the court prayed at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大雩于圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, a great rain prayer ceremony was held at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, the court held a great rain prayer ceremony at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 浙西郡县及蜀十五郡皆大旱。

translations.literal: The commanderies and counties of western Zhe and fifteen commanderies of Shu all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies and counties of western Zhe and fifteen commanderies in Shu all suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 二年春，旱，至于夏秋。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, drought lasted until summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year drought persisted through summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 七月庚午，大雩于圜丘，祈于宗社。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day gengwu, a great rain prayer ceremony was held at the Circular Mound, and prayers were offered at the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the day gengwu, the court held a great rain prayer ceremony at the Circular Mound and prayed at the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 浙西、湖南、江东旱，镇江、建康府、常、秀、潭、永州为甚。

translations.literal: Western Zhe, Hunan, and Jiangdong had drought; Zhenjiang and Jiankang Prefectures and Chang, Xiu, Tan, and Yong prefectures were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe, Hunan, and Jiangdong were dry; Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Changzhou, Xiuzhou, Tanzhou, and Yongzhou were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，不雨，至于七月。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, no rain until the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year it did not rain until the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 浙东西、江西郡国旱。

translations.literal: The commanderies and kingdoms of eastern and western Zhe and Jiangxi had drought.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of eastern and western Zhe and Jiangxi suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 开禧元年夏，浙东、西不雨百余日，衢、婺、严、越、鼎、沣、忠、涪州大旱。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Kaixi, eastern and western Zhe had no rain for more than a hundred days; Qu, Wu, Yan, Yue, Ding, Feng, Zhong, and Fu prefectures had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Kaixi, eastern and western Zhe went more than a hundred days without rain, and Quzhou, Wuzhou, Yanzhou, Yuezhou, Dingzhou, Fengzhou, Zhongzhou, and Fuzhou suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 二年，南康军、江西、湖南北郡县旱。

translations.literal: In the second year, Nankang Army and the northern commanderies and counties of Jiangxi and Hunan had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Nankang and the northern commanderies and counties of Jiangxi and Hunan were dry.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，不雨；

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, no rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year it did not rain.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，祷于郊丘、宗社。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, prayers were offered at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, the court prayed at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年夏，旱，闰月辛卯，祷于郊丘、宗社。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Jiading, drought; in the intercalary month, on the day xinmao, prayers were offered at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Jiading there was drought; in the intercalary month, on the day xinmao, the court prayed at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 二年夏四月，旱，首种不入，庚申，祷于郊丘、宗社。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year's summer, drought; the first planting could not be done; on the day gengshen, prayers were offered at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year drought struck and the first planting could not be done; on the day gengshen the court prayed at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，又祷，至于七月乃雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yiyou, prayers were offered again; rain came only in the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day yiyou, the court prayed again, and rain did not come until the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 浙西大旱，常、润为甚。

translations.literal: Western Zhe had great drought; Chang and Run were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe suffered severe drought, and Changzhou and Runzhou were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 淮东西、江东、湖北皆旱。

translations.literal: Eastern and western Huai, Jiangdong, and Hubei all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and western Huai, Jiangdong, and Hubei all were dry.

sentences.zh: 四年，资、普、昌、合州旱。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Zi, Pu, Chang, and He prefectures had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Zizhou, Puzhou, Changzhou, and Hezhou all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，不雨，至于七月，江陵、德安、汉阳军旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, no rain until the seventh month; Jiangling, Dean, and Hanyang armies had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year it did not rain until the seventh month, and Jiangling, Dean, and Hanyang were dry.

sentences.zh: 入年春，旱，首种不入。

translations.literal: In the spring of the following year, drought; the first planting could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring brought drought, and the first planting could not be done.

sentences.zh: 四月乙未，祷于太乙宫。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day yiwei, prayers were offered at the Taiyi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day yiwei, the court prayed at the Taiyi Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命辅臣分祷郊丘、宗社。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, chief ministers were ordered to pray separately at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, the emperor ordered chief ministers to pray separately at the suburban mound and the altars of the ancestral temple and soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 五月康申，大雩于园丘，有事于岳、渎、海、至于八月乃雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, a great rain prayer ceremony was held at the Circular Mound; rites were performed for peaks, rivers, and seas; rain came only in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengshen day, the court held a great rain prayer ceremony at the Circular Mound and performed rites for peaks, rivers, and seas; rain did not come until the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 江、浙、淮、闽皆旱，建康、宁国府、衢、婺、温、台、明、徽、池、真、太平州、广德、兴国、南康、盱眙、安丰军为甚，行都百泉皆竭，淮甸亦然。

translations.literal: Jiang, Zhe, Huai, and Min all had drought; Jiankang and Ningguo Prefectures; Qu, Wu, Wen, Tai, Ming, Hui, Chi, Zhen, and Taiping prefectures; Guangde, Xingguo, Nankang, Xuyi, and Anfeng armies were especially severe. All the springs of the traveling capital dried up, and the same was true of the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang, Zhe, Huai, and Fujian all were dry; Jiankang, Ningguo, Quzhou, Wuzhou, Wenzhou, Taizhou, Mingzhou, Huizhou, Chizhou, Zhenzhou, Taiping, Guangde, Xingguo, Nankang, Xuyi, and Anfeng were hit especially hard; every spring in the traveling capital ran dry, and the Huai region fared no better.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，不雨，帝日午曝立，祷于宫中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, no rain; at midday the emperor stood exposed to the blazing sun and prayed within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year it did not rain; at midday the emperor stood bareheaded in the blazing sun and prayed within the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，不雨，至于冬，淮郡及镇江、建宁府、常州、江阴、广德军旱。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year, no rain until winter; the Huai commanderies and Zhenjiang, Jianning Prefecture, Chang Prefecture, Jiangyin, and Guangde Army had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eleventh year it did not rain until winter, and the Huai commanderies, Zhenjiang, Jianning, Changzhou, Jiangyin, and Guangde all were dry.

sentences.zh: 十四年，浙、闽、广、江西旱，明、台、衢、婺、温、福、赣、吉州、建昌军为甚。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Zhe, Min, Guang, and Jiangxi had drought; Ming, Tai, Qu, Wu, Wen, Fu, Gan, Ji prefectures, and Jianchang Army were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangxi suffered drought; Mingzhou, Taizhou, Quzhou, Wuzhou, Wenzhou, Fuzhou, Ganzhou, Jizhou, and Jianchang were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，不雨，岳州旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year, no rain; Yue Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year it did not rain, and Yuezhou was dry.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年夏，建康府旱。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Jiaxi, Jiankang Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Jiaxi, Jiankang suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 三年，旱。

translations.literal: In the third year, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year there was drought.

sentences.zh: 四年，江、浙、福建旱。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Jiang, Zhejiang, and Fujian all were dry.

sentences.zh: 淳祐七年，旱。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chunyou, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chunyou there was drought.

sentences.zh: 十一年，闽、广及饶州旱。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Min, Guang, and Rao Prefecture had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Fujian, Guangdong, and Raozhou suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 咸淳六年，江南大旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianchun, Jiangnan had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xianchun, Jiangnan suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 十年，庐州旱，长乐、福清二县大旱。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Lu Prefecture had drought; Changle and Fuqing counties had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Luzhou was dry, and Changle and Fuqing counties suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 建隆中，京师士庶及乐工、少年竞唱歌曰《五来子》。

translations.literal: During Jianlong, the capital's gentry and commoners, musicians, and youths all vied to sing a song called "The Five Come."
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianlong era, gentry and commoners in the capital, together with musicians and youths, all vied to sing a popular song called "The Five Come."

sentences.zh: 自建隆、开宝，凡平荆、湖、川、广、江南，五国皆来朝。

translations.literal: From Jianlong and Kaibao onward, having pacified Jing, Hu, Chuan, Guang, and Jiangnan, all five realms came to court.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jianlong and Kaibao reigns onward, as Jing, Hu, Sichuan, Guang, and Jiangnan were pacified in turn, all five realms came to pay court.

sentences.zh: 时西川孟昶赋敛无度，射利之家配率尤甚，既乏缗钱，唯仰在质物。

translations.literal: At that time in western Sichuan, Meng Chang's levies knew no limit; usurious households imposed apportioned exactions with especial severity. Lacking cash, people could rely only on pledged collateral items.
translations.idiomatic: At that time in western Sichuan, Meng Chang's exactions knew no bounds, and usurious households imposed apportioned levies with especial harshness; short of cash, people had no recourse but to their pledged collateral items.

sentences.zh: 乃竞书简札揭于门曰：“今召主收赎。

translations.literal: They then all vied to write notices and post them on their doors, saying: "The master is summoned to redeem today."
translations.idiomatic: People then vied to write notices and post them on their doors: "The master is summoned to redeem today."

sentences.zh: ”又每岁除日，命翰林为词题桃符，正旦置寝门左右。

translations.literal: Again, each year on New Year's Eve, the Hanlin Academy was ordered to compose verses for peach talismans, which were placed on either side of the bedroom door on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: Each New Year's Eve the Hanlin Academy was ordered to compose verses for peach talismans, which were hung on either side of the bedroom door on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 末年，学士幸寅逊撰词，昶以其非工，自命笔题云：“新年纳余庆，嘉节号长春。

translations.literal: In his final year, Academician Xing Yinsun drafted the verse, but Chang, finding it poorly wrought, took up the brush himself and wrote: "The new year receives Yu Qing; the fine festival is called Everlasting Spring."
translations.idiomatic: In his final year, Academician Xing Yinsun drafted the verse, but Chang, finding it poorly wrought, took up the brush himself and wrote: "The new year receives Yu Qing; the fine festival is called Everlasting Spring."

sentences.zh: ”昶以其年正月降王师，即命吕余庆知成都府，而“长春”乃太祖诞圣节名也，“召”与“赵”、“赎”与“蜀”同音。

translations.literal: " In the first month of that year Chang surrendered to the imperial army, and Lü Yuqing was immediately appointed prefect of Chengdu; yet "Everlasting Spring" was the name of Taizu's birthday festival, and "summoned" homophonized with "Zhao," while "redeem" homophonized with "Shu."
translations.idiomatic: That first month Chang surrendered to the imperial army, and Lü Yuqing was immediately appointed prefect of Chengdu; yet "Everlasting Spring" was the name of Taizu's birthday festival, "summoned" homophonized with "Zhao," and "redeem" with "Shu."

sentences.zh: 开宝初，广南刘鋹令民家置贮水桶，号“防火大桶”。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaibao, Liu Chang of southern Guang ordered every household to keep storage water buckets called "great fire-prevention buckets."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaibao, Liu Chang of southern Guang ordered every household to keep storage water buckets called "great fire-prevention buckets."

sentences.zh: 又鋹末年，童谣曰：“羊头二四，白天雨至。

translations.literal: Again, in Liu Chang's final year, a children's rhyme ran: "Sheep's head, two-four; by day the timely rain arrives."
translations.idiomatic: In Liu Chang's final year, a children's rhyme ran: "Sheep's head, two-four; by day the timely rain arrives."

sentences.zh: ”后王师以辛未年二月四日擒鋹。

translations.literal: Later the imperial army captured Chang on the fourth day of the second month of the xinwei year.
translations.idiomatic: Later the imperial army captured Chang on the fourth day of the second month of the xinwei year.

sentences.zh: 识者以为国家以火德王，房为宋分；

translations.literal: Those who understood such things held that the dynasty ruled by the virtue of Fire, and the asterism Fang was Song's allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: Those versed in such omens held that the dynasty ruled by the virtue of Fire and that the asterism Fang was Song's allotted region.

sentences.zh: 羊，未神也；

translations.literal: Sheep is the wei spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep corresponds to the wei branch.

sentences.zh: 雨者，王师如时雨之义也；

translations.literal: Rain signifies the imperial army as timely rain.
translations.idiomatic: Rain signified the imperial army coming like timely rain.

sentences.zh: “防”与“房”、“桶”与“宋”同音。

translations.literal: "Prevent" homophonized with "Fang," and "bucket" homophonized with "Song."
translations.idiomatic: "Prevent" homophonized with "Fang," and "bucket" with "Song."

sentences.zh: 周广顺初，江南伏龟山圮，得石函，长二尺，广八寸，中有铁铭，云：“维天监十四年秋八月，葬宝公于是。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhou Guangshun, in Jiangnan the Fugui Mountain collapsed, and a stone casket was found, two chi long and eight cun wide, containing an iron inscription that read: "In the autumn eighth month of the fourteenth year of Tianjian, Lord Bao was buried here."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhou Guangshun era, Fugui Mountain in Jiangnan collapsed, revealing a stone casket two chi long and eight cun wide containing an iron inscription: "In the autumn eighth month of the fourteenth year of Tianjian, Lord Bao was buried here."

sentences.zh: ”铭有引曰：“宝公尝为偈，大事书于版，帛幂之。

translations.literal: " The inscription had a preface saying: "Lord Bao once composed a gatha; the great matter was written on a board and covered with silk."
translations.idiomatic: The inscription carried a preface: "Lord Bao once composed a gatha; the great matter was written on a board and covered with silk."

sentences.zh: 人欲读之者，必施数钱乃得，读讫即幂之。

translations.literal: Whoever wished to read it had to offer a few coins before being allowed; once read, it was covered again.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever wished to read it had to offer a few coins first; once read, it was covered again.

sentences.zh: 是时，名士陆倕、王筠、姚察而下皆莫知其旨。

translations.literal: At that time, eminent men from Lu Chuo and Wang Jun and Yao Cha downward all failed to know its meaning.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, eminent men from Lu Chuo and Wang Jun down to Yao Cha all failed to grasp its meaning.

sentences.zh: 或问之，云在五百年后。

translations.literal: When asked about it, he said it would be understood five hundred years later.
translations.idiomatic: When asked, he said its meaning would be understood five hundred years later.

sentences.zh: 至卒，乃归其铭同葬焉。

translations.literal: At his death, the inscription was returned and buried with him.
translations.idiomatic: At his death the inscription was returned and buried with him.

sentences.zh: ”铭曰：“莫问江南事，江南自有冯。

translations.literal: " The inscription reads: "Ask not of Jiangnan affairs; Jiangnan has its own Feng."
translations.idiomatic: The inscription reads: "Ask not of Jiangnan affairs; Jiangnan has its own Feng."

sentences.zh: 乘鸡登宝位，跨犬出金陵。

translations.literal: Riding a cock, he ascends the precious throne; straddling a dog, he departs Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Riding a cock, he ascends the precious throne; straddling a dog, he departs Jinling.

sentences.zh: 子建司南位，安仁秉夜灯。

translations.literal: Zijian holds the southern position; Anren bears the night lamp.
translations.idiomatic: Zijian holds the southern position; Anren bears the night lamp.

sentences.zh: 东邻家道阙，随虎遇明兴。

translations.literal: The eastern neighbor's household way is broken; following the tiger, he meets bright ascent.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern neighbor's household way is broken; following the tiger, he meets bright ascent.

sentences.zh: ”其字皆小篆，体势完具，徐铉、徐锴、韩熙载皆不能解。

translations.literal: " Its characters were all in small seal script, complete in form and structure; Xu Xuan, Xu Kai, and Han Xizai could none of them decipher it.
translations.idiomatic: Its characters were all in small seal script, complete in form and structure; Xu Xuan, Xu Kai, and Han Xizai could none of them decipher it.

sentences.zh: 及煜归朝，好事者云：煜丁酉年袭位，即乘鸡也；

translations.literal: When Yu returned to the court, enthusiasts said: Yu succeeded to the throne in the dingyou year, which is riding the cock.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu submitted to the court, enthusiasts said that Yu had succeeded to the throne in the dingyou year—this was riding the cock.

sentences.zh: 开宝八年甲戌，江南国灭，是跨犬也；

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kaibao, on the day jiaxu, the Jiangnan state perished—this is straddling the dog.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Kaibao, on the day jiaxu, the Jiangnan state perished—this was straddling the dog.

sentences.zh: 当王师围其城而曹彬营其南，是子建司南位；

translations.literal: When the imperial army besieged the city and Cao Bin encamped to the south, this is Zijian holding the southern position.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army besieged the city and Cao Bin encamped to the south, this was Zijian holding the southern position.

sentences.zh: 潘美营其北，是安仁秉夜灯也；

translations.literal: Pan Mei encamped to the north—this is Anren bearing the night lamp.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mei encamped to the north—this was Anren bearing the night lamp.

sentences.zh: 其后太平兴国三年，淮海王钱俶举国入觐，即东邻也；

translations.literal: Later, in the third year of Taiping Xingguo, Qian Chu, Prince of Huaihai, brought his entire realm to court—this is the eastern neighbor.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in the third year of Taiping Xingguo, Qian Chu, Prince of Huaihai, brought his entire realm to court—this was the eastern neighbor.

sentences.zh: 家道阙，意无钱也；

translations.literal: The household way is broken—meaning no Qian.
translations.idiomatic: The household way is broken—meaning the loss of Qian.

sentences.zh: 随虎遇，戊寅年也。

translations.literal: Following the tiger to meet—this is the wuyin year.
translations.idiomatic: Following the tiger to meet—this was the wuyin year.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年正月戊午，狄青败侬智高于归仁铺。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year of Huangyou, on the day wuwu, Di Qing defeated Nong Zhigao at Guirenpu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year of Huangyou, on the day wuwu, Di Qing defeated Nong Zhigao at Guirenpu.

sentences.zh: 初，谣言“农家种，籴家收”。

translations.literal: Earlier, a rumor ran: "The farming house sows; the grain-buying house reaps."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a popular rumor had run: "The farming house sows; the grain-buying house reaps."

sentences.zh: 至是，智高果为青所破。

translations.literal: At this time, Zhigao was indeed defeated by Qing.
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, Zhigao was indeed defeated by Qing.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年四月，鼎州桃源洞大水，巨石随流而下，有文曰：“无为大道，天知人情；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Jianyan, great flood at Taoyuan Cave in Ding Prefecture; a huge stone came down with the current bearing an inscription: "The Way of Nonaction is the great Way; Heaven knows human feelings."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Jianyan, a great flood struck Taoyuan Cave in Dingzhou; a huge stone came down with the current bearing an inscription: "The Way of Nonaction is the great Way; Heaven knows human feelings."

sentences.zh: 无为窈冥，神见人形。

translations.literal: Nonaction is deep and dark; the spirit sees human form.
translations.idiomatic: Nonaction is deep and dark; the spirit sees human form.

sentences.zh: 心言意语，鬼闻人声；

translations.literal: What the heart thinks and the mind speaks— ghosts hear human voices;
translations.idiomatic: What the heart thinks and the mind murmurs— ghosts hear human voices;

sentences.zh: 犯禁满盈，地收人魂。

translations.literal: When transgressions reach their fill, the earth gathers human souls.
translations.idiomatic: When transgressions brim over, the earth gathers human souls.

sentences.zh: ”金石同类，类金为变怪者也。

translations.literal: " Metal and stone are of the same category; portents of the Metal type are strange transformations.
translations.idiomatic: Metal and stone belong to the same category; anomalies classified under Metal are precisely such strange transformations.

sentences.zh: 绍兴二年，李纲帅长沙，道过建宁，僧宗本题邑治之壁曰：“东烧西烧，日月七七。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing, Li Gang commanded at Changsha; passing through Jianning, the monk Zongben wrote on the wall of the district seat: "Burn east, burn west— sun and moon, seven seven."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoxing, Li Gang held command at Changsha. Passing through Jianning, the monk Zongben wrote on the wall of the district seat: "Burn east, burn west— sun and moon, seven seven."

sentences.zh: ”后数日，江西盗李敦仁入境，焚其邑，七月七日也。

translations.literal: Days later, the Jiangxi bandit Li Dunren entered the territory and burned the district—it was the seventh day of the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: Days later the Jiangxi bandit Li Dunren crossed the border, burned the district, and the day was the seventh of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 淳熙中，淮西竞歌汪秀才曲曰：“骑驴渡江，过江不得。

translations.literal: During the Chunxi era, west of the Huai River people vied to sing Scholar Wang's tune: "Riding a donkey to cross the river— cannot cross the river."
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunxi era, people west of the Huai vied to sing the Scholar Wang ballad: "Riding a donkey to cross the river— yet never crossing."

sentences.zh: ”又为犭枼舞以和之。

translations.literal: They also performed a dog dance to accompany it.
translations.idiomatic: They also danced a dog dance in time with it.

sentences.zh: 后舒城狂生汪格谋不轨，州兵入其家，缚之。

translations.literal: Later the Shucheng scholar-at-large Wang Ge plotted treason; prefectural troops entered his home and bound him.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Shucheng scholar-at-large Wang Ge plotted sedition; prefectural troops entered his home and bound him.

sentences.zh: 其子拒杀，聚恶少数千为乱，声言渡江。

translations.literal: His son resisted and killed them; gathering several thousand ruffians he raised a revolt, declaring they would cross the river.
translations.idiomatic: His son resisted and killed them, then gathered several thousand ruffians into revolt, proclaiming they would cross the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 事平，格亦伏诛。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Ge was also executed.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Ge was executed as well.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，余杭门外墙壁有诗，其言颇涉怪，后廉得主名，杖遣之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, verse appeared on a wall outside Yuhang Gate; its language touched heavily on the strange. The author was later traced, flogged, and banished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, verse appeared on a wall outside Yuhang Gate; its language touched heavily on the uncanny. The author was later traced, flogged, and banished.

sentences.zh: 主管城北厢刘君暨以失察异言，坐削秩，其诗不录。

translations.literal: Supervisor Liu Junji of the North City Ward, for failing to detect subversive speech, was demoted in rank; the poem is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Liu Junji of the North City Ward, for failing to detect seditious speech, was stripped of rank; the poem is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 十四年，都城市井歌曰：“汝亦不来我家，我亦不来汝家。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, city folk in the capital sang: "You do not come to my house, and I do not go to yours."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, city folk in the capital sang: "You do not come to my house, and I do not go to yours."

sentences.zh: ”至绍熙二三年，其事始应于两宫。

translations.literal: By the second and third years of Shaoxi, the matter was finally fulfilled with regard to the two palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the second and third years of Shaoxi did the matter at last find its fulfillment in the estrangement of the two palaces.

sentences.zh: 嘉定三年，都城市井作歌词，末句皆曰“东君去后花无主”，朝廷恶而禁之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiading, city folk in the capital composed songs whose closing line all ran, "After the Lord of the East departs, the flowers have no master"; the court detested this and forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiading, city folk in the capital composed songs whose closing line always ran, "After the Lord of the East departs, the flowers have no master"; the court detested this and forbade it.

sentences.zh: 未几，太子询薨。

translations.literal: Before long, Crown Prince Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Crown Prince Xun died.

sentences.zh: 庆元四年三月甲辰，有邮筩置诗达御前者，诏宰臣究其诗，不录。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the third month in the fourth year of Qingyuan, someone placed a postal tube bearing a poem that reached the emperor; the emperor ordered the chief ministers to investigate the poem, which is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen of the third month in the fourth year of Qingyuan, someone placed a postal tube bearing a poem that reached the emperor; the emperor ordered the chief ministers to investigate it, but the poem is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰四年，越人盛歌《铁弹子白塔湖曲》。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiatai, people of Yue widely sang the song 《Iron Pellet White Tower Lake Ballad》.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiatai, people of Yue widely sang 《Iron Pellet White Tower Lake Ballad》.

sentences.zh: 俄有盗金十一者自号“铁弹子”，缪传其斗死于白塔湖中，后获于诸暨县。

translations.literal: Before long a band of eleven gold robbers appeared whose leader styled himself "Iron Pellet"; false report circulated that he had died fighting in White Tower Lake, but he was later captured in Zhuji County.
translations.idiomatic: Before long a band of eleven gold robbers appeared whose leader styled himself "Iron Pellet"; rumor falsely spread that he had died fighting in White Tower Lake, but he was later captured in Zhuji County.

sentences.zh: 汉乾祐中，荆南高从诲凿池于山亭下，得石匣，长尺余，扃鐍甚固。

translations.literal: In the Qianyou reign of Later Han, Gao Conghui of Jingnan excavated a pool beneath the mountain pavilion and found a stone casket more than a chi long, its bolt and lock extremely firm.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianyou reign of Later Han, Gao Conghui of Jingnan excavated a pool beneath the mountain pavilion and found a stone casket more than a foot long, its bolt and lock extremely firm.

sentences.zh: 从诲神之，屏左右，焚香以启匣，中得石，有文云：“此去遇龙即歇。

translations.literal: Conghui regarded it as divine; dismissing his attendants, he burned incense and opened the casket. Inside he found a stone inscribed: "When you next meet the dragon, then you may rest."
translations.idiomatic: Conghui regarded it as divine; dismissing his attendants, he burned incense and opened the casket. Inside was a stone inscribed: "From here on, when you meet the dragon, then you may rest."

sentences.zh: ”及建隆中，从诲孙继冲入朝，改镇徐州。

translations.literal: When in the Jianlong era his grandson Jichong entered court, he was reassigned to govern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When in the Jianlong era his grandson Jichong entered court, he was reassigned to govern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: “龙”、“隆”音相近。

translations.literal: For "dragon" (long) and "Jianlong" (long) are near in sound.
translations.idiomatic: For long ("dragon") and long (in Jianlong) are near in sound.

sentences.zh: 太平兴国中，京师儿童以木雕合子，中有窍，藏腋下有声，号云“腋底闹”。

translations.literal: During Taiping Xingguo, capital children used wooden box-toys with holes inside; hidden under the armpit they made a noise, called "Racket under the Armpit."
translations.idiomatic: During Taiping Xingguo, capital children played with wooden box-toys hollowed inside; tucked under the armpit they rattled, and the toy was called "Racket under the Armpit."

sentences.zh: 后卢多逊投荒，人以为谶，其在肘腋而司国典也。

translations.literal: Later when Lu Duoxun was banished to the frontier, people took it as a portent that he was in the emperor's armpit yet held the nation's statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Later when Lu Duoxun was banished to the frontier, people took it as a portent: he had been at the emperor's elbow and armpit, yet held the nation's statutes in his hands.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年五月，西京讹言有物如乌帽，夜飞入人家，又变为犬狼状。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Tianxi, a false rumor in the Western Capital said something like a black hat flew into people's houses at night and also changed into the shape of dogs and wolves.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Tianxi, a false rumor spread in the Western Capital that something like a black hat flew into people's houses at night and also changed into the shape of dogs and wolves.

sentences.zh: 人民多恐骇，每夕重闭深处，至持兵器驱逐者。

translations.literal: People were greatly terrified; each night they bolted themselves deep indoors, and some even took up weapons to drive it off.
translations.idiomatic: People were greatly terrified; each night they bolted themselves deep indoors, and some even took up weapons to drive the thing off.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，传及京师，云能食人。

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the sixth month the rumor reached the capital, saying it could devour people.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi of the sixth month the rumor reached the capital, saying the creature could devour people.

sentences.zh: 里巷聚族环坐，叫噪达曙，军营中尤甚，而实无状，意其妖人所为。

translations.literal: Neighborhoods gathered by clan in rings, shouting until dawn; it was worst in the camps, yet in truth there was no such thing— they reckoned it the work of sorcerers.
translations.idiomatic: Neighborhoods gathered by clan in rings, shouting until dawn; it was worst in the camps, yet in truth there was no such creature— they reckoned it the work of sorcerers.

sentences.zh: 有诏严捕，得数辈，讯之，皆非。

translations.literal: An edict ordered stern capture; several parties were seized and interrogated, but none proved true.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered stern capture; several parties were seized and interrogated, but none proved to be responsible.

sentences.zh: 政和七年，诏修神保观，俗所谓“二郎神”者。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhenghe, an edict ordered repairs to the Temple of the Divine Protector— what the people call the "Second Lord God."
