translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhenghe, an edict ordered repairs to the Temple of the Divine Protector— what common folk call the "Second Lord God."

sentences.zh: 京师人素畏之，自春及夏，倾城男女负土以献，揭榜通衢，云某人献土；

translations.literal: Capital folk had long feared him; from spring through summer, men and women across the city carried soil as offerings. Proclamations lined the thoroughfares: "So-and-so presents soil."
translations.idiomatic: Capital folk had long feared him; from spring through summer, men and women across the city carried soil as offerings. Proclamations lined the thoroughfares: "So-and-so presents soil."

sentences.zh: 又有饰形作鬼使，巡门催纳土者。

translations.literal: Some even disguised themselves as demon envoys to go door to door demanding soil.
translations.idiomatic: Some even disguised themselves as demon envoys and went door to door demanding soil.

sentences.zh: 或以为不祥，禁绝之。

translations.literal: Some thought this ill-omened and forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: Some thought this ill-omened and put a stop to it.

sentences.zh: 后金人斡离不围京师，其国谓之“二郎君”云。

translations.literal: Later when the Jurchen Wolibu besieged the capital, his state called him the "Second Lord Lord"— so they said.
translations.idiomatic: Later when the Jurchen Wolibu besieged the capital, his own people called him the "Second Lord Lord"— so it was said.

sentences.zh: 绍兴元年十二月，越州连火，民讹言相惊，月几望当再火。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Shaoxing, a string of fires struck Yuezhou; popular rumor spread mutual alarm, saying that near the full moon there would be fire again.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Shaoxing, a string of fires struck Yuezhou; popular rumor spread panic among the people, saying that near the full moon there would be fire again.

sentences.zh: 枢密院以军法禁之，乃定。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs forbade it under military law, and then calm returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs forbade it under military law, and calm returned.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年六月，故循王张俊家火。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Jiatai, fire struck the home of the late Prince of Xun, Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Jiatai, fire struck the home of the late Prince of Xun, Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 后旬日，市井讹言相惊，绛衣妇人为火殃下坠。

translations.literal: A dozen days later, street rumor spread alarm again— a woman in scarlet robes would fall as a fire calamity.
translations.idiomatic: A dozen days later, street rumor spread panic again: a woman in scarlet robes would fall as a fire calamity.

sentences.zh: 都民徙避，昼夜弗宁，禁之，后亦不火。

translations.literal: Capital residents moved away to avoid it; day and night knew no peace. After it was forbidden, no fire came again.
translations.idiomatic: Capital residents moved away to avoid it; day and night knew no peace. Once it was forbidden, no further fire came.

sentences.zh: 庆元六年十月，琼州讹言妖星流堕民郭七家，声如雷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Qingyuan, a false rumor in Qiongzhou said a demonic star streaming down had fallen on seven households outside the town wall, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Qingyuan, a false rumor in Qiongzhou said a demonic star streaming down had fallen on seven households outside the town wall, with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 通判曾丰暨琼山县令移文惊扰，后皆坐绌。

translations.literal: Assistant Prefect Zeng Feng and the Qiongshan magistrate sent documents that caused panic and alarm; afterward both were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Prefect Zeng Feng and the Qiongshan magistrate sent documents that stirred panic and alarm; afterward both were demoted.

sentences.zh: 签书枢密院事林存为似道所摈，道死于漳。

translations.literal: Lin Cun, Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ostracized by Jia Sidao and died on the road at Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Cun, Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ostracized by Jia Sidao and died on the road at Zhang.

sentences.zh: 漳有富民蓄油煔木甚佳，林氏子弟求之，价高不可得，因抚其木曰：“收取收取，待贾丞相用。

translations.literal: At Zhang a wealthy man kept excellent oil-cured burial timber; Lin's sons asked to buy it but the price was high and they could not obtain it. They therefore patted the wood and said: "Collect it, collect it— save it for Chancellor Jia to use."
translations.idiomatic: At Zhang a wealthy man kept excellent oil-cured burial timber; Lin's sons sought to buy it but the price was high and they could not obtain it. They therefore patted the wood and said: "Collect it, collect it— save it for Chancellor Jia to use."

sentences.zh: ”德祐元年，似道谪死，郡守与之经营，竟得此木以殓。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou, Sidao was demoted and died; the prefect worked on his funeral and in the end obtained this wood for his coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Deyou, Sidao was demoted and died; the prefect arranged his funeral and in the end obtained this very wood for his coffin.

sentences.zh: 宋初，陈抟有纸钱使不行之说，时天下惟用铜钱，莫喻此旨。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, Chen Tuan had a prophecy that paper money would not circulate; at that time the realm used only copper cash, and none understood his meaning.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Song, Chen Tuan prophesied that paper money would not circulate; at that time the realm used only copper cash, and none understood what he meant.

sentences.zh: 其后用交子、会子，其后会价愈低，故有“使到十八九，纸钱飞上天”之谣。

translations.literal: Later they used jiaozi and huizi; later still huizi's exchange value fell lower and lower— hence the rhyme: "By eighteen or nineteen, paper money flies to the sky."
translations.idiomatic: Later they used jiaozi and huizi; as huizi's exchange value fell ever lower, a rhyme spread: "By eighteen or nineteen, paper money flies to the sky."

sentences.zh: 似道恶十九界之名，乃名关子，然终为十九界矣，而关子价益低，是纸钱使不行也。

translations.literal: Sidao hated the name "Nineteenth Circle" and renamed it guanzi— yet in the end it still became the nineteenth circle; guanzi's value fell even lower. This was paper money failing to circulate.
translations.idiomatic: Sidao hated the name "Nineteenth Circle" and renamed the notes guanzi— yet in the end they still became the nineteenth circle, and guanzi's value fell even lower. This was paper money failing to circulate.

sentences.zh: 建隆三年，有象至黄陂县匿林中，食民苗稼，又至安、复、襄、唐州践民田，遣使捕之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianlong, an elephant came to Huangpi County and hid in the woods, eating the people's millet; it also reached An, Fu, Xiang, and Tang prefectures and trampled fields— an envoy was sent to capture it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianlong, an elephant came to Huangpi County and hid in the woods, eating the people's crops; it also reached An, Fu, Xiang, and Tang prefectures and trampled fields, and an envoy was sent to capture it.

sentences.zh: 明年十二月，于南阳县获之，献其齿革。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the following year, it was seized in Nanyang County; its tusk and hide were presented.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the following year, it was seized in Nanyang County, and its tusk and hide were presented.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年五月，有象至澧阳、安乡等县，又有象涉江入华容县，直过阛阓门；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Qiande, elephants came to Liyang and Anxiang counties; another elephant crossed the river into Huarong County and passed straight through the market gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Qiande, elephants came to Liyang and Anxiang counties; another elephant crossed the river into Huarong County and passed straight through the market gate.

sentences.zh: 又有象至澧州澧阳县城北。

translations.literal: Another elephant came north of Liyang city in Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Another elephant came to the north of Liyang city in Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾德四年八月，普州兔食禾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Qiande, rabbits in Puzhou ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Qiande, rabbits in Puzhou ate the grain.

sentences.zh: 五年，有象自至京师。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an elephant came of itself to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an elephant came of its own accord to the capital.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，有犀自黔南入万州，民捕杀之，获其皮角。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, a rhinoceros from Qiannan entered Wanzhou; the people captured and killed it and obtained its hide and horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongxi, a rhinoceros from Qiannan entered Wanzhou; the people captured and killed it and obtained its hide and horn.

sentences.zh: 开宝八年四月，平陆县鸷兽伤人，遣使捕之，生献十头。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year of Kaibao, a fierce beast in Pinglu County injured people; an envoy was sent to capture them and ten were brought in alive.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year of Kaibao, a fierce beast in Pinglu County injured people; an envoy was sent to hunt it, and ten were brought in alive.

sentences.zh: 十月，江陵府白昼虎入市，伤二人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, in broad daylight a tiger entered the market in Jiangling Prefecture and injured two people.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, in broad daylight a tiger entered the market in Jiangling Prefecture and injured two people.

sentences.zh: 太平兴国三年，果、阆、蓬、集诸州虎为害，遣殿直张延钧捕之，获百兽。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo, tigers harmed people in Guo, Lang, Peng, and Ji prefectures; Palace Direct Zhang Yanjun was sent to hunt them and captured a hundred beasts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo, tigers ravaged Guo, Lang, Peng, and Ji prefectures; Palace Direct Zhang Yanjun was sent to hunt them and captured a hundred beasts.

sentences.zh: 俄而七盘县虎伤人，延钧又杀虎七以为献。

translations.literal: Soon after, a tiger in Qipan County injured people; Yanjun killed seven more tigers and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, a tiger in Qipan County injured people; Yanjun killed seven more tigers and presented them as tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年，虎入萧山县民赵驯家，害八口。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, a tiger entered the home of Zhao Xun of Xiaoshan County and killed eight members of the household.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, a tiger entered the home of Zhao Xun of Xiaoshan County and killed eight members of the household.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年十月，桂州虎伤人，诏遣使捕之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Chunhua, a tiger injured people in Guizhou; an edict ordered an envoy to hunt it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Chunhua, a tiger injured people in Guizhou; an edict ordered an envoy sent to hunt it.

sentences.zh: 至道元年六月，梁泉县虎伤人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhidao, a tiger injured people in Liangquan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhidao, a tiger injured people in Liangquan County.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，苏州虎夜入福山砦，食卒四人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year, a tiger entered Fushan stockade in Suzhou by night and devoured four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year, a tiger entered Fushan stockade in Suzhou by night and devoured four soldiers.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年十二月，黄州长析村二虎夜斗，一死，食之殆半，占云：“守臣灾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Xianping, two tigers fought by night in Changxi Village, Huangzhou; one died and the other ate nearly half of it. Prognostication said: "Calamity for the guarding minister."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Xianping, two tigers fought by night in Changxi Village in Huangzhou; one died and the other ate nearly half of it. Prognostication said: "Calamity for the guarding minister."

sentences.zh: ”明年，知州王禹偁卒。

translations.literal: The following year, Prefect Wang Yucheng died.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Prefect Wang Yucheng died.

sentences.zh: 咸平六年十月乙酉，有狐出皇城东北角楼，历军器库至夹道，获之。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou of the tenth month in the sixth year of Xianping, a fox emerged from the northeast corner tower of the Imperial City, passed through the Armory to the lane between walls, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou of the tenth month in the sixth year of Xianping, a fox emerged from the northeast corner tower of the Imperial City, passed through the Armory to the lane between walls, and was captured.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符九年三月，杭州浙江侧，昼有虎入税场，巡检俞仁祐挥戈杀之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, by day a tiger entered the tax office on the Zhejiang River in Hangzhou; Patrol Officer Yu Renyou wielded his halberd and killed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, by day a tiger entered the tax office on the Zhe River in Hangzhou; Patrol Officer Yu Renyou wielded his halberd and killed it.

sentences.zh: 天圣九年五月，宿州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year of Tiansheng, Suzhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year of Tiansheng, Suzhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 六月，庐州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Luzhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Luzhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 明道二年六月，唐州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Mingdao, Tangzhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Mingdao, Tangzhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 皇祐三年十二月，泰州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Huangyou, Taizhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year of Huangyou, Taizhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐三年六月丁卯，交阯贡异兽二。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the sixth month in the third year of Jiayou, Jiaozhi presented two rare beasts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao of the sixth month in the third year of Jiayou, Jiaozhi presented two rare beasts.

sentences.zh: 初，本国称贡骐驎，状如牛身，被肉甲，鼻端有角，食生刍果，必先以杖击其角，然后食。

translations.literal: At first the native state claimed they were qilin: they resembled cattle, with armored flesh on their bodies; horns on their snouts; they ate fresh grass and fruit and always had to be struck on the horn with a staff before they would eat.
translations.idiomatic: At first the native state claimed they were qilin: shaped like cattle, with fleshy armor on their bodies and horns on their snouts; they ate fresh grass and fruit, but always had to be struck on the horn with a staff before they would eat.

sentences.zh: 既至，而枢密使田况辨其非麟，诏止称异兽。

translations.literal: When they arrived, Privy Councilor Tian Kuang identified them as not true qilin; an edict ordered they be called only rare beasts.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived, Privy Councilor Tian Kuang identified them as not true qilin; an edict ordered that they be called only rare beasts.

sentences.zh: 熙宁元年九月，抚州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Xining, Fuzhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Xining, Fuzhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 十二月，岚州获白鹿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Lanzhou captured a white deer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Lanzhou captured a white deer.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，庐州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year, Luzhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year, Luzhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 政和五年十二月，安化军获白兔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifth year of Zhenghe, Anhua Circuit captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fifth year of Zhenghe, Anhua Circuit captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 六月，泰州军获白兔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Taizhou Circuit captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Taizhou Circuit captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，达州获白兔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year, Dazhou captured a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventh year, Dazhou captured a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年十月，淄州获黑兔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Xuanhe, Zizhou captured a black rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Xuanhe, Zizhou captured a black rabbit.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年秋，有狐由艮岳直入禁中，据御榻而坐，诏毁狐王庙。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the seventh year of Xuanhe, a fox entered the forbidden precinct directly from Gen Peak and sat upon the imperial couch; an edict ordered the Fox King Temple destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the seventh year of Xuanhe, a fox came straight from Gen Peak into the forbidden precinct and sat upon the imperial couch; an edict ordered the Fox King Temple destroyed.

sentences.zh: 绍兴十一年，海州属金，悉空其民安江。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Shaoxing, Haizhou came under Jin rule; the Jin emptied all its people and resettled them along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Shaoxing, Haizhou came under Jin rule; the Jin emptied all its people and resettled them along the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 后二十年，有二虎入城，人射杀之，虎亦搏人。

translations.literal: Twenty years later, two tigers entered the city; people shot and killed them, and the tigers also mauled people.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty years later, two tigers entered the city; people shot and killed them, and the tigers also mauled people.

sentences.zh: 明年，魏胜举州来归，亦空其民。

translations.literal: The following year, Wei Sheng brought the whole prefecture over to the Song and likewise emptied its people.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Wei Sheng brought the whole prefecture over to the Song and likewise emptied its people.

sentences.zh: 汉龚遂曰：“野兽入宫室，宫室将空。

translations.literal: Gong Su of Han said: "When wild beasts enter palace chambers, the palace chambers will be emptied."
translations.idiomatic: Gong Su of Han said: "When wild beasts enter palace chambers, the palace chambers will be emptied."

sentences.zh: ”虎豕皆毛孽也。

translations.literal: Tigers and swine are both calamities among hairy creatures.
translations.idiomatic: Tigers and swine are both calamities among hairy creatures.

sentences.zh: 十三年，南康县雷雨，群狸震死于岩穴中，岩石皆为碎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, thunder and rain in Nankang County; a pack of wildcats was struck dead in a cliff cave, the rock itself shattered to pieces.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, thunder and rain struck Nankang County; a pack of wildcats was killed by lightning in a cliff cave, and the rock itself was shattered to pieces.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，刘彭老家猫产数子，皆三足。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the house cat of Liu Peng's family gave birth to several kittens, all with three legs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, the house cat of Liu Peng's family gave birth to several kittens, all with three legs.

sentences.zh: 乾道七年，潮州野象数百食稼，农设穽田间，象不得食，率其群围行道车马，敛谷食之，乃去。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao, hundreds of wild elephants in Chaozhou ate the crops; farmers set pit traps in the fields and the elephants could not eat. They led their herd to surround travelers' carts and horses on the road, gathered grain to eat, and only then departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Qiandao, hundreds of wild elephants in Chaozhou ate the crops; farmers set pit traps in the fields so the elephants could not feed. They led their herd to surround travelers' carts and horses on the road, gathered grain to eat, and only then departed.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年，江州马当山群狐掠人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunxi, a pack of foxes on Madang Mountain in Jiangzhou attacked people.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunxi, a pack of foxes on Madang Mountain in Jiangzhou attacked people.

sentences.zh: 十年，滁州有熊虎同入樵民舍，夜，自相搏死。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, a bear and a tiger together entered a woodcutter's hut in Chuzhou; by night they fought each other to the death.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, a bear and a tiger together entered a woodcutter's hut in Chuzhou; by night they fought each other to the death.

sentences.zh: 绍熙元年三月，临安府民家猫生子一，有八足二尾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Shaoxi, a cat in a household of Lin'an Prefecture gave birth to one kitten with eight legs and two tails.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Shaoxi, a cat in a Lin'an household gave birth to a single kitten with eight legs and two tails.

sentences.zh: 四年，鄂州武昌县虎为人患。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, tigers troubled the people of Wuchang County in Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, tigers troubled the people of Wuchang County in Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，扬州献白兔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year, Yangzhou presented a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year, Yangzhou presented a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 侍御史章颖劾守臣钱之望以孽为瑞。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Ying impeached the guarding minister Qian Zhiwang for treating a calamity as an auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Ying impeached the guarding minister Qian Zhiwang for treating a calamity as an auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 占曰：“国有忧。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The state will know sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication says: "The state will know sorrow."

sentences.zh: ”白，丧祥也。

translations.literal: White is the omen of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: White is the omen of mourning.

sentences.zh: 是岁，光宗崩。

translations.literal: That year, Emperor Guangzong died.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Emperor Guangzong died.

sentences.zh: 庆元三年，德兴县群狐入民舍。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qingyuan, packs of foxes entered households in Dexing County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qingyuan, packs of foxes entered households in Dexing County.

sentences.zh: 咸淳九年十一月辛卯黎明，有虎出于扬州市，毛色微黑，都拨发官曹安国率良家子数十人射之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the ninth year of Xianchun, at dawn on xinmao day, a tiger emerged in Yangzhou city; its fur was slightly black. Metropolitan deployment officer Cao Anguo led several dozen sons of good households to shoot it.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on xinmao day in the eleventh month of the ninth year of Xianchun, a tiger emerged in Yangzhou; its coat was slightly black. Metropolitan deployment officer Cao Anguo led several dozen local militiamen to shoot it.

sentences.zh: 制置使李庭芝占曰：“千日之内，杀一大将。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Li Tingzhi prognosticated, saying: "Within a thousand days, a great general will be killed."
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Li Tingzhi read the omen and said, "Within a thousand days a great general will be slain."

sentences.zh: ”于是脔其肉于城外而厌之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they cut up its flesh outside the city and performed apotropaic rites with it.
translations.idiomatic: They then cut up its flesh outside the city walls and performed apotropaic rites to dispel the omen.

sentences.zh: 绍兴六年四月，中京大雪、雷震，犬数十争赴土河而死，可救者才二三。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year of Shaoxing, at the Central Capital there was heavy snow and thunder; several dozen dogs rushed together into an earthen river and died—only two or three could be saved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year of Shaoxing, the Central Capital saw heavy snow and thunder; dozens of dogs rushed into a muddy river and drowned, and only two or three could be saved.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年六月，饶州大雷震犬于市之旅舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Chunxi, at Raozhou a great thunderbolt struck a dog in an inn in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Chunxi, a great thunderbolt struck a dog at a market inn in Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 庆元二年，抚州有犬若人，坐于郡守之坐。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingyuan, at Fuzhou a dog like a human being sat in the prefect's seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingyuan, at Fuzhou a dog sat upright like a man in the prefect's own chair.

sentences.zh: 未几，郡守林廷彦卒于官。

translations.literal: Before long, the prefect Lin Tingyan died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the prefect Lin Tingyan died in office.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年五月壬申，扬州禁军民毋得蓄犬，城中杀犬数万，输皮纳官。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the fifth month of the first year of Deyou, Yangzhou forbade soldiers and civilians to keep dogs; within the city several tens of thousands of dogs were killed, their hides delivered and turned in to the government.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the fifth month of the first year of Deyou, Yangzhou forbade soldiers and civilians to keep dogs; tens of thousands were slaughtered in the city, their hides confiscated for the state.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年七月己卯夜，西方起苍白气，长五十尺，贯天船、五车，亘井宿，占曰：“主兵动。

translations.literal: On the night of jimao day in the seventh month of the third year of Qiande, pale white vapor rose in the west, fifty chi long, piercing Celestial Boat and the Five Chariots and stretching across the Well mansion. Prognostication says: "Warfare will stir."
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jimao day in the seventh month of the third year of Qiande, pale white vapor rose in the west, fifty chi long, crossing Celestial Boat and the Five Chariots and spanning the Well mansion. Prognostication says: "Warfare will stir."

sentences.zh: ”六年十月己未旦，西北起苍白气三道，长二十尺，趋东散，占曰：“游兵之象。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month of the sixth year, at dawn on jiwei day, three streaks of pale white vapor rose in the northwest, twenty chi long, trending eastward and dispersing. Prognostication says: "The image of roaming troops."
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on jiwei day in the tenth month of the sixth year, three streaks of pale white vapor rose in the northwest, twenty chi long, drifting eastward before dispersing. Prognostication says: "This is the sign of roaming troops."

sentences.zh: 太平兴国四年四月己未夜，西北有白气压北斗。

translations.literal: On the night of jiwei day in the fourth month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, in the northwest there was white vapor pressing upon the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiwei day in the fourth month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, white vapor in the northwest pressed upon the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年正月癸酉，白气起角、亢经，太微垣，历轩辕大星，至月傍散。

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the first month of the fourth year of Yongxi, white vapor rose from Horn and Neck, passed through the Supreme Palace Enclosure, crossed the great star of Xuanyuan, and dispersed beside the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the first month of the fourth year of Yongxi, white vapor rose from Horn and Neck, passed through the Supreme Palace Enclosure and the great star of Xuanyuan, then dispersed beside the moon.

sentences.zh: 至道二年二月丙子夜，西方有苍白气，长短八道，如彗扫稍，经天汉，参错如交蛇，占曰：“所见之方主兵胜。

translations.literal: On the night of bingzi day in the second month of the second year of Zhidao, in the west there was pale white vapor, eight streaks of varying length, like a comet sweeping its tail, crossing the Celestial River and intertwining like crossing serpents. Prognostication says: "The direction where it is seen will prevail in war."
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingzi day in the second month of the second year of Zhidao, pale white vapor appeared in the west in eight streaks of varying length, like a comet's sweeping tail crossing the Milky Way and writhing like intertwined serpents. Prognostication says: "The region where it appears will prevail in war."

sentences.zh: 咸平四年三月丙申，白气二亘天。

translations.literal: On bingshen day in the third month of the fourth year of Xianping, two white vapors stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the third month of the fourth year of Xianping, two bands of white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，白气如虹贯日，久而散。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, white vapor like a rainbow pierced the sun; after a long while it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, white vapor arched like a rainbow across the sun and, after a long while, dispersed.

sentences.zh: 七月戊戌，白气如阵贯东井。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the seventh month, white vapor like a battle formation pierced the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the seventh month, white vapor arrayed like a battle formation pierced the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 六年四月己巳，白气东西亘天。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the fourth month of the sixth year, white vapor stretched east and west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the fourth month of the sixth year, white vapor stretched from east to west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，白气贯日。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, white vapor pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, white vapor crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，白气出昴至壁没。

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the fifth month, white vapor emerged from the Pleiades and set at the Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the fifth month, white vapor rose from the Pleiades and vanished at the Wall.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，白气出河鼓左右旗，分为数道没。

translations.literal: On bingzi day in the sixth month, white vapor emerged from the left and right banners of the Drum at the River, divided into several streaks, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the sixth month, white vapor rose from the left and right banners of the Drum at the River, split into several streaks, and disappeared.

sentences.zh: 七月癸卯，白气如彗，起西南方，占曰：“有兵丧。

translations.literal: On guimao day in the seventh month, white vapor like a comet rose in the southwest. Prognostication says: "There will be war and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the seventh month, comet-like white vapor rose in the southwest. Prognostication says: "War and mourning will follow."

sentences.zh: 景德元年五月，白气贯轩辕，苍白气十余如布亘天。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jingde, white vapor pierced Xuanyuan; more than ten streaks of pale white vapor like cloth stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Jingde, white vapor crossed Xuanyuan, and more than ten bands of pale white vapor like draped cloth spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 二年二月丁亥，白气五道贯北斗，占为大风、幸臣忧。

translations.literal: On dinghai day in the second month of the second year, five streaks of white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper; prognosticated as great wind and concern for favored ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the second month of the second year, five streaks of white vapor crossed the Northern Dipper, prognosticated as great wind and trouble for favored ministers.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子，白气出阁道西，孛孛有光，占曰：“宫中忧。

translations.literal: On bingzi day in the tenth month, white vapor emerged west of the Palace Corridor, broom-star bright; prognostication says: "Anxiety within the palace."
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the tenth month, white vapor rose west of the Palace Corridor, blazing like a broom star. Prognostication says: "There will be anxiety within the palace."

sentences.zh: ”三年三月，白气贯月。

translations.literal: " In the third month of the third year, white vapor pierced the moon.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, white vapor crossed the moon.

sentences.zh: 四年三月己未，白气东西亘天。

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the third month of the fourth year, white vapor stretched east and west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the third month of the fourth year, white vapor stretched from east to west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚申，白气出南方，长二丈许，久而不散。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, white vapor emerged in the south, about two zhang long, lasting a long time without dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, white vapor rose in the south, about two zhang long, and lingered without dispersing.

sentences.zh: 四月庚午，白气贯北斗，长十丈，占为大风。

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the fourth month, white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper, ten zhang long; prognosticated as great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the fourth month, white vapor ten zhang long crossed the Northern Dipper, prognosticated as a great wind.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，白气如布袭月，三丈许。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, white vapor like cloth enveloped the moon, about three zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, white vapor like a cloth shroud enveloped the moon, about three zhang across.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年正月丁丑，白气二，东西亘天。

translations.literal: On dingchou day in the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, two white vapors stretched east and west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, two bands of white vapor stretched from east to west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 五年二月壬寅，白气长五丈，出东井，贯北斗魁及轩辕，占为兵、为雷雨。

translations.literal: On renyin day in the second month of the fifth year, white vapor five zhang long emerged from the Eastern Well, pierced the Chariot of the Northern Dipper and Xuanyuan; prognosticated as warfare and thunder-rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the second month of the fifth year, white vapor five zhang long rose from the Eastern Well and crossed the Chariot of the Northern Dipper and Xuanyuan, prognosticated as warfare and thunderstorms.

sentences.zh: 明道元年十二月壬戌，西北有苍白气亘天。

translations.literal: On renxu day in the twelfth month of the first year of Mingdao, in the northwest there was pale white vapor stretching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the twelfth month of the first year of Mingdao, pale white vapor in the northwest spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 庆历元年八月庚辰夜，东方有白气长十尺许，在星宿度中，至十日，长丈余，冲天，九十余日没。

translations.literal: On the night of gengchen day in the eighth month of the first year of Qingli, in the east there was white vapor about ten chi long, within the degrees of the lodges; by the tenth day it was more than one zhang long, soaring to the zenith; after more than ninety days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengchen day in the eighth month of the first year of Qingli, white vapor about ten chi long appeared in the east within the lodge degrees; by the tenth day it had grown to more than one zhang and shot toward the zenith, and after more than ninety days it vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年八月甲申，白气贯北斗。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the eighth month of the second year, white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the eighth month of the second year, white vapor crossed the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊戌，中天有白气长二十尺，向西南行贯日，占曰：“边兵忧。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the first month of the third year, at mid-heaven there was white vapor twenty chi long, moving southwest and piercing the sun. Prognostication says: "Anxiety over frontier troops."
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the first month of the third year, white vapor twenty chi long stood at mid-heaven, moved southwest, and crossed the sun. Prognostication says: "There will be anxiety over frontier troops."

sentences.zh: ”四月癸卯，白气二生西北隅，上中天，首尾至浊，东南行，良久散，占曰：“其下有兵寇。

translations.literal: " On guimao day in the fourth month, two white vapors arose in the northwest corner, ascended to mid-heaven, their heads and tails reaching the murky depths, moving southeast; after a long while they dispersed. Prognostication says: "Below them there will be raiding troops."
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the fourth month, two white vapors rose in the northwest, climbed to mid-heaven with heads and tails reaching the murky horizon, and drifted southeast before dispersing after a long while. Prognostication says: "Raiders will appear below."

sentences.zh: ”八月壬子夜，白气贯北斗魁。

translations.literal: " On the night of renzi day in the eighth month, white vapor pierced the Chariot of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renzi day in the eighth month, white vapor crossed the Chariot of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳夜，中天有白气长二丈许，贯卷舌、南河，东北行，少顷散，占曰：“风雨之候。

translations.literal: On the night of xinsi day in the ninth month, at mid-heaven there was white vapor about two zhang long, piercing Rolled Tongue and South River, moving northeast; in a little while it dispersed. Prognostication says: "The sign of wind and rain."
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinsi day in the ninth month, white vapor about two zhang long stood at mid-heaven, crossed Rolled Tongue and South River, and moved northeast before dispersing shortly afterward. Prognostication says: "Wind and rain are near."

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年十一月辛酉夜，白气起北方近浊，长五丈许，历北斗，久之散，占曰：“多大风。

translations.literal: On the night of xinyou day in the eleventh month of the fourth year of Huangyou, white vapor rose in the north near the murky depths, about five zhang long, passing through the Northern Dipper; after a long while it dispersed. Prognostication says: "Much great wind."
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinyou day in the eleventh month of the fourth year of Huangyou, white vapor about five zhang long rose in the north near the murky horizon, passed through the Northern Dipper, and after a long while dispersed. Prognostication says: "Great winds will be frequent."

sentences.zh: 嘉祐元年三月，彭城县白鹤乡地生面，占曰：“地生面，民将饥。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Jiayou, at Baihe Township in Pengcheng County, flour was produced from the ground. Prognostication says: "When the earth produces flour, the people will hunger."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Jiayou, flour sprang from the ground at Baihe Township in Pengcheng County. Prognostication says: "When the earth yields flour, the people will go hungry."

sentences.zh: ”五月，钟离县地生面。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, at Zhongli County flour was produced from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month flour also sprang from the ground at Zhongli County.

sentences.zh: 治平二年四月丙午夜，西北方有白气，渐东南行，首尾至浊，贯角宿，移西北，久方散。

translations.literal: On the night of bingwu day in the fourth month of the second year of Zhiping, in the northwest there was white vapor, gradually moving southeast; its head and tail reached the murky depths, piercing the Horn mansion; it shifted northwest, and only after a long while dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingwu day in the fourth month of the second year of Zhiping, white vapor appeared in the northwest and drifted gradually southeast, its ends reaching the murky horizon as it crossed the Horn mansion; it then shifted northwest and only dispersed after a long while.

sentences.zh: 占曰：“有兵战疾疫事。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "There will be warfare and pestilence."
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication says: "Warfare and pestilence will follow."

sentences.zh: 熙宁九年四月庚寅夜，白气长丈，起东北方天市垣。

translations.literal: On the night of gengyin day in the fourth month of the ninth year of Xining, white vapor one zhang long rose in the northeast from the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengyin day in the fourth month of the ninth year of Xining, white vapor one zhang long rose in the northeast from the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 元祐三年七月戊辰夜，西北有白气经天，主兵，宜防西、北二鄙。

translations.literal: On the night of wuchen day in the seventh month of the third year of Yuanyou, in the northwest there was white vapor crossing the sky; it presaged warfare—one should guard against the two western and northern border regions.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuchen day in the seventh month of the third year of Yuanyou, white vapor in the northwest crossed the sky, presaging warfare; the western and northern frontiers should be guarded.

sentences.zh: 元符二年九月戊辰夜，有白气十道，各长五尺，主兵及大臣黜。

translations.literal: On the night of wuchen day in the ninth month of the second year of Yuanfu, there were ten streaks of white vapor, each five chi long; they presaged warfare and the dismissal of great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuchen day in the ninth month of the second year of Yuanfu, ten streaks of white vapor appeared, each five chi long, presaging warfare and the dismissal of great ministers.

sentences.zh: 崇宁二年五月戊子夜，苍白气起东南方，长三丈，贯尾、箕、斗，主蛮夷入贡，旧臣来归。

translations.literal: On the night of wuzi day in the fifth month of the second year of Chongning, pale white vapor rose in the southeast, three zhang long, piercing Tail, Winnowing Basket, and Dipper; it presaged barbarian tribute and the return of former ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi day in the fifth month of the second year of Chongning, pale white vapor three zhang long rose in the southeast, crossing Tail, Winnowing Basket, and Dipper, presaging tribute from barbarian peoples and the return of former ministers.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年九月壬午夜，苍白气长三丈，贯月，主其下有乱者。

translations.literal: On the night of renwu day in the ninth month of the third year of Xuanhe, pale white vapor three zhang long pierced the moon; it presaged rebellion below.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renwu day in the ninth month of the third year of Xuanhe, pale white vapor three zhang long crossed the moon, presaging rebellion in the land below.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年十二月丙辰，白气出太微垣。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the twelfth month of the first year of Jingkang, white vapor emerged from the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the twelfth month of the first year of Jingkang, white vapor rose from the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 二年二月壬午夜，白气如虹，自南亘北，须臾，移西南，至东北，天明而没。

translations.literal: On the night of renwu day in the second month of the second year, white vapor like a rainbow stretched from south to north; in a moment it shifted southwest to northeast, and at daybreak vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renwu day in the second month of the second year, white vapor arched like a rainbow from south to north; in a moment it shifted from southwest to northeast, and vanished at daybreak.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，白气贯斗。

translations.literal: On wuzi day in the third month, white vapor pierced the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the third month, white vapor crossed the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，杜充为北京留守，天雨纸钱于营中，厚盈寸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan, Du Chong served as northern capital garrison commander; spirit money rained in the camp, piled an inch thick.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan, while Du Chong served as garrison commander of the northern capital, spirit money rained in the camp until it lay an inch deep.

sentences.zh: 明日，与金人战城下，败绩。

translations.literal: The next day he fought the Jurchens below the city walls and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he fought the Jurchens beneath the walls and was routed.

sentences.zh: 纸，白祥也。

translations.literal: Paper is a white auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Paper belongs to the category of white portents.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，白气贯日。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, white vapor pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, white vapor crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 四年五月壬子夜，北方有白气十余道如练。

translations.literal: On the night of renzi day in the fifth month of the fourth year, in the north there were more than ten streaks of white vapor like silk.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renzi day in the fifth month of the fourth year, more than ten bands of white vapor like silk threads appeared in the north.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月辛酉夜，天雨水银。

translations.literal: On the night of xinyou day in the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year, mercury rained from heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinyou day in the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year, mercury rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 绍兴元年，潭州得白玉于州城莲花池中，孔彦舟以献，诏却之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing, Tanzhou obtained white jade in the lotus pond within the prefectural city; Kong Yanzhou presented it, and an edict rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing, white jade was found in the lotus pond within Tanzhou's city walls; Kong Yanzhou presented it, but an edict refused the offering.

sentences.zh: 前史以为玉变近白祥，后彦舟为剧盗。

translations.literal: Earlier histories hold that jade changing form approaches a white auspice; later Yanzhou became a notorious bandit.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier histories treated the transformation of jade as a white portent; later Yanzhou became a notorious bandit.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳夜，东南有白气。

translations.literal: On the night of jisi day in the second month, in the southeast there was white vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jisi day in the second month, white vapor appeared in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月庚申，金人居长安，油、酒皆变白色。

translations.literal: On gengshen day in the third month of the eleventh year, the Jurchens occupied Chang'an; oil and wine all turned white.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the third month of the eleventh year, while the Jurchens held Chang'an, oil and wine all turned white.

sentences.zh: 三十年十一月甲午夜，西南有白气出危，入昴。

translations.literal: On the night of jiawu day in the eleventh month of the thirtieth year, in the southwest white vapor emerged from Rooftop and entered the Pleiades.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiawu day in the eleventh month of the thirtieth year, white vapor in the southwest rose from Rooftop and entered the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，白气出尾，入轸，贯天市垣。

translations.literal: On wushen day in the twelfth month, white vapor emerged from Tail, entered Chariot Platform, and pierced the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the twelfth month, white vapor rose from Tail, entered Chariot Platform, and crossed the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 三十一年十二月辛丑，白气如带，东西亘天，出斗，历牛。

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the twelfth month of the thirty-first year, white vapor like a belt stretched east and west across the sky, emerging from the Dipper and passing through Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the twelfth month of the thirty-first year, white vapor like a belt spanned the sky from east to west, rising from the Dipper and passing through Ox.

sentences.zh: 隆兴元年十二月壬午夜，白气见西南方，出危，入昴。

translations.literal: On the night of renwu day in the twelfth month of the first year of Longxing, white vapor appeared in the southwest, emerging from Rooftop and entering the Pleiades.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renwu day in the twelfth month of the first year of Longxing, white vapor appeared in the southwest, rising from Rooftop and entering the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 二年正月甲寅夜，西南有白气，亘天如带。

translations.literal: On the night of jiayin day in the first month of the second year, in the southwest there was white vapor stretching across the sky like a belt.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiayin day in the first month of the second year, white vapor in the southwest spanned the heavens like a belt.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年正月庚午，白气见西北方，出奎，入参。

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the first month of the first year of Qiandao, white vapor appeared in the northwest, emerging from Legs and entering Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the first month of the first year of Qiandao, white vapor appeared in the northwest, rising from Legs and entering Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，白气如带，自参及角，东西亘天。

translations.literal: On wuchen day in the third month, white vapor like a belt stretched from Three Stars to Horn, east and west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the third month, white vapor like a belt stretched from Three Stars to Horn across the sky from east to west.

sentences.zh: 四月丁酉夜，白气见西北方，入天市垣。

translations.literal: On the night of dingyou day in the fourth month, white vapor appeared in the northwest and entered the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingyou day in the fourth month, white vapor appeared in the northwest and entered the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛丑夜，白气入北斗。

translations.literal: On the night of xinchou day, white vapor entered the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinchou day, white vapor entered the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙巳夜，白气入紫微垣。

translations.literal: On the night of yisi day, white vapor entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yisi day, white vapor entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑夜，苍白气见东南方，入翼。

translations.literal: On the night of jichou day in the tenth month, pale white vapor appeared in the southeast and entered Wings.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jichou day in the tenth month, pale white vapor appeared in the southeast and entered Wings.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，白气如带，出女，入昴，东西亘天。

translations.literal: On bingyin day in the eleventh month, white vapor like a belt emerged from Maid, entered the Pleiades, and stretched east and west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the eleventh month, white vapor like a belt rose from Maid, entered the Pleiades, and spanned the sky from east to west.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月庚午夜，白气如带，东西亘天，出女，入昴。

translations.literal: On the night of gengwu day in the twelfth month of the third year, white vapor like a belt stretched east and west across the sky, emerging from Maid and entering the Pleiades.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengwu day in the twelfth month of the third year, white vapor like a belt spanned the sky from east to west, rising from Maid and entering the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十年正月戊子夜，西南有白气如天汉而明，南北广可六丈，东西亘天，历壁至毕。

translations.literal: On the night of wuzi day in the first month of the tenth year of Chunxi, in the southwest there was white vapor bright like the Celestial River, about six zhang wide north to south, stretching east and west across the sky, passing from Wall to Net.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi day in the first month of the tenth year of Chunxi, white vapor bright as the Milky Way appeared in the southwest, about six zhang wide from north to south, spanning the heavens from east to west from Wall to Net.

sentences.zh: 绍熙五年六月壬寅夜，白气亘天，自紫微至亢、角。

translations.literal: On the night of renyin day in the sixth month of the fifth year of Shaoxi, white vapor stretched across the sky from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure to Horn and Neck.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renyin day in the sixth month of the fifth year of Shaoxi, white vapor spanned the heavens from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure to Horn and Neck.

sentences.zh: 己酉日入后，白气亘天，顷刻而散。

translations.literal: After sunset on jiyou day, white vapor stretched across the sky and dispersed in an instant.
translations.idiomatic: After sunset on jiyou day, white vapor spanned the heavens and dispersed in a moment.

sentences.zh: 庆元四年八月庚辰，白气亘天。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the eighth month of the fourth year of Qingyuan, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the eighth month of the fourth year of Qingyuan, white vapor spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 五年二月癸酉夜，东北方白气如带，自角至参。

translations.literal: On the night of guiyou day in the second month of the fifth year, in the northeast white vapor like a belt stretched from Horn to Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiyou day in the second month of the fifth year, white vapor like a belt in the northeast stretched from Horn to Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，东北方有白气如带，亘天。

translations.literal: On guihai day in the eighth month, in the northeast there was white vapor like a belt stretching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the eighth month, white vapor like a belt in the northeast spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰四年十一月辛未，昼有白气分数道，亘天。

translations.literal: On xinwei day in the eleventh month of the fourth year of Jiatai, in daylight white vapor split into several streaks stretching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the eleventh month of the fourth year of Jiatai, white vapor split into several streaks in broad daylight and spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年二月丙辰，白气亘天。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the second month of the fourth year of Jiaxi, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the second month of the fourth year of Jiaxi, white vapor spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年二月甲寅，白气亘天。

translations.literal: On jiayin day in the second month of the second year of Chunyou, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the second month of the second year of Chunyou, white vapor spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 景定三年七月甲申，白气如匹布，亘天。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the seventh month of the third year of Jingding, white vapor like a bolt of cloth stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the seventh month of the third year of Jingding, white vapor like a bolt of cloth spanned the heavens.

sentences.zh: 咸三九年，襄阳城中白气自西而出。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianchun, white vapor emerged from the west within Xiangyang city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Xianchun, white vapor rose from the west within the walls of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 绍兴二年，宣州有铁佛象，坐高丈余，自动迭前迭却若伛而就人者数日，既而郡有火。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing, at Xuanzhou there was an iron Buddha image, seated more than one zhang high; for several days it moved forward and back on its own as if bowing toward people; before long the commandery suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoxing, at Xuanzhou an iron Buddha image more than one zhang high sat in its shrine; for several days it moved forward and back on its own as if bowing toward people, and before long the commandery was struck by fire.

sentences.zh: 火气盛，金失其性而为变怪也。

translations.literal: Fire's qi was flourishing; Metal lost its nature and produced strange transformations.
translations.idiomatic: Fire's power was ascendant; Metal had lost its proper nature and gave rise to these uncanny transformations.

sentences.zh: 七月，天雨钱，或从石甃中流出，有轮郭，肉好不分明，穿之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, coins rained from heaven; some flowed out from stone drains, with rims and square holes though rim and hole were indistinct; when pierced for stringing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, coins rained from the sky; some issued from stone drains with rims and square holes though poorly formed, and were pierced for stringing.

sentences.zh: 碎若沙土。

translations.literal: they shattered like sand and soil.
translations.idiomatic: they crumbled like sand.

sentences.zh: 二月，温州戒福寺铜佛象顶珠自动，光彩激射，经日不少停，数日火作，寺焚。

translations.literal: In the second month, at Jiefu Temple in Wenzhou the top pearl of a bronze Buddha image moved on its own; brilliant light shot forth without ceasing all day; after several days fire arose and the temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, at Jiefu Temple in Wenzhou the jewel atop a bronze Buddha image turned on its own, casting dazzling light without pause for a whole day; within days fire broke out and the temple burned to the ground.

sentences.zh: 淳熙九年春，德兴县民家镜自飞舞，与日光相射。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year of Chunxi, at a commoner's home in Dexing County a mirror flew and danced on its own, flashing against the sunlight.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year of Chunxi, a mirror in a commoner's home at Dexing County danced in the air on its own, flashing against the sunlight.

sentences.zh: 庆元二年正月，泰宁县耕夫得镜，厚三寸，径尺有二寸，照见水底，与日争辉，病热者对之，心骨生寒，后为雷震而碎。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Qingyuan, a plowman at Taining County obtained a mirror three cun thick and one chi and two cun in diameter; it could illuminate the bottom of water and vie in brilliance with the sun; one afflicted with heat illness who faced it felt cold in heart and bone; later it was shattered by thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Qingyuan, a plowman in Taining County unearthed a mirror three cun thick and one chi two cun across; it could light the riverbed and outshine the sun, and a man burning with fever who looked into it felt cold pierce his heart and bones; later it was shattered by a thunderbolt.
